raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

raw.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making autism and ADHD care more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. Through a modern, tech-enabled care model, they help patients navigate evaluations and therapy with greater clarity, communication, and support. They are a small, highly collaborative team that values ownership, responsiveness, operational clarity, and calm execution under pressure.

About the Role

They are looking for a highly organized, empathetic, and resourceful Care Concierge / Patient Intake Coordinator to serve as the primary point of contact for patients and families throughout their care journey. The aim is to ensure patients receive the level of service and compassion one would want for their loved ones.

This role combines customer support, scheduling, coordination, patient communication, clinician coordination, administrative follow-through, and operational problem-solving.

They will help families:

  • Schedule evaluations
  • Complete required paperwork
  • Navigate insurance and intake requirements
  • Understand next steps
  • Stay informed throughout the process

Many of the families spoken with may already feel overwhelmed, confused, or frustrated before reaching the company. The ability to communicate clearly, stay organized, and calmly guide conversations forward will play a major role in the overall patient experience.

This is not a passive call center role. They are looking for someone who can think critically, follow structured workflows carefully, manage multiple moving parts at once, and operate independently in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

The role serves as the primary point of contact for the company's patients and families via phone, email, and live chat:

  • Schedule and coordinate diagnostic evaluations
  • Collect and verify intake information, insurance details, and required documentation
  • Follow up with patients regarding missing forms or appointment requirements
  • Respond professionally and empathetically to patient questions and concerns
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within internal systems
  • Coordinate with operations and clinical teams to resolve scheduling or workflow issues
  • Research and provide post-diagnosis support resources when needed
  • Help identify recurring operational issues and suggest workflow improvements

What They're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-volume or emotionally sensitive situations
  • Comfortable managing multiple conversations and tasks simultaneously
  • Reliable remote work setup with high-speed internet
  • Backup power and backup internet solution available during outages
  • Ability to work primarily during US business hours
  • Comfortable working independently within a structured remote workflow

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous healthcare support, patient coordination, or customer service experience
  • Experience working remotely in fast-paced environments
  • Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Zendesk, Intercom, or EHR systems
  • Basic understanding of healthcare or insurance terminology

What They Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Competitive monthly compensation
  • A supportive and collaborative startup team
  • Opportunity to help shape and improve patient experience operations
  • Meaningful work supporting families through important healthcare decisions
  • High-autonomy environment focused on results, communication, and accountability
  • Zero micromanagement

Application Process

All applicants will complete:

  1. A short application questionnaire
  2. A brief video interview with the recruitment team
  3. A final interview with the hiring manager
  4. If all goes well, an offer of employment

They review applications carefully and prioritize candidates who demonstrate strong communication, professionalism, operational thinking, and attention to detail. They look forward to hearing from applicants.

The company is committed to building an inclusive and supportive remote work environment for talented professionals globally.

The Coder II is responsible for abstracting and assigning valid CPT, ICD-10, HCPCs and modifiers to ensure appropriate reimbursement in accordance with federal, state, and private health plans as well as organization and regulatory guidance. We're currently hiring Senior Electrical Engineers across multiple renewable energy business units, including:

  • Storage - Estimating Engineering

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you'll play a key role in delivering safe, reliable, and innovative engineering solutions across utility-scale renewable energy projects. Depending on your background and interests, you'll support projects during either the preconstruction/estimating phase or project execution phase, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality engineering solutions from concept through construction.

A typical day may involve developing electrical designs, reviewing engineering packages, supporting utility interconnections, coordinating with Owners and Engineers of Record (EOR), evaluating constructability, and solving complex technical challenges across multiple concurrent projects. You'll work closely with Engineering, Estimating, Integrated Supply Chain, Construction, and Project Management to ensure designs are safe, economical, constructible, and aligned with client requirements.

Whether you're supporting Solar Project Engineering, Wind Estimating Engineering, or Battery Energy Storage Estimating Engineering, you'll contribute to projects that include underground collection systems, substations, transmission interconnections, protection and control systems, power quality studies, SCADA and communications, and utility-scale renewable energy infrastructure.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Develop electrical engineering solutions supporting utility-scale renewable energy projects through either estimating or project execution.
  • Lead electrical design development, Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, engineering reviews, RFIs, and technical deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review electrical one-line diagrams, protection and control systems, grounding plans, cable routing, equipment layouts, and third-party engineering packages to ensure quality and compliance.
  • Collaborate with Owners, Engineers of Record (EOR), Estimating, Project Engineering, Integrated Supply Chain, and Construction teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective designs.
  • Support utility interconnections, electrical equipment selection, procurement strategies, and technical submittal reviews.
  • Perform quantity takeoffs, constructability reviews, value engineering, and technical risk assessments that improve project execution and proposal competitiveness.
  • Mentor Engineer I, Engineer II, and CAD Designers through technical guidance, coaching, and engineering best practices.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining engineering quality, schedule commitments, and client expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen engineering standards, workflows, and design quality.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an ABET-accredited college.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification required, or ability to obtain within one year of hire.
  • Four or more years of progressive electrical engineering experience supporting utility-scale power generation, renewable energy, industrial, EPC, or heavy infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing multiple engineering priorities while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Experience supporting utility-scale solar, wind, or battery energy storage (BESS) projects.
  • Strong knowledge of underground collection systems, substations, transmission interconnections, protection and control systems, SCADA, power quality, load flow analysis, and electrical equipment sizing.
  • Experience in either Estimating Engineering (preconstruction) or Project Engineering (project execution), or a combination of both.
  • Experience collaborating with Owners, Engineers of Record (EOR), utilities, EPC partners, and construction teams throughout the engineering lifecycle.
  • Passion for solving complex engineering challenges, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving engineering quality and project delivery.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay
  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)
  • Work/Life balance

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with the wider NBA platform stack, including React/TypeScript, Java services, and Decision Intelligence systems.
  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling, auditability, and compliance requirements.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Specialist Quality Assurance

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide quality assurance support to the PQ organization as a subject matter expert of quality systems and records. In this team-based role you will directly add to the success of the Product Quality team by collaborating within PQ and with diverse levels in functional areas including Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Regulatory, Quality Engineering, International Quality and Process development on projects, issue resolution and investigations. The QA Specialist will use technical abilities and knowledge of QMS processes, procedures, and regulations to lead and deliver quality assurance responsibilities while owning, reviewing, and/or approving Product Quality records and documentation including: product specifications, in-process control specifications, specification technical reports, annual product reviews (APRs), international expansion forms, change control records, appendix docs (data sheets and data analysis), Deviation Investigations/Root Cause Analysis, CAPAs, analytical comparability protocols, analytical comparability reports, and procedures. Additionally, this role will approve commercial variation records (GDCR), and may provide training to other staff.

Responsibilities:

As a team member you will use your technical abilities to execute transactions in GMP systems (Veeva CDOCs, Trackwise, etc.) and may include additional business process support for APRs and site audits, as needed. The QA specialist may also support managing products in the annual product review cycles at Amgen.

  • Provide QA Systems expertise and QA support to the Product Quality organization (PQ and Stability) by working within a team environment.

  • Provide Product Quality QA support to one or more of Amgen's clinical and commercial products by working directly with Product Quality Leaders and Principal Product Quality Leaders on QA tasks.

  • Responsible for QA tasks in support of both clinical and commercial Product Quality Leaders, including ownership, QA review and approval of documents (Protocols, Reports, Specifications, IPC’s, Annual Product Review, etc.), and execution of transactions (Owner and/or QA Contact) in relevant GMP systems (VEEVA CDOCS, Change Control, Deviation/CAPA, etc.) and may include additional business process support.

  • Support of audits/inspections, APR management, and other processes as required.

  • Supporting/facilitating continuous improvement initiatives intended to increase Quality systems efficiencies within and outside of the PQ organization.

  • Interact with other functional areas within Amgen such as Corporate Quality, International Quality, Quality Control, Regulatory, Process Development, Site Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, etc.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek will have these qualifications.

  • Doctorate degree Or

  • Master’s degree and 2 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific, or Manufacturing experience Or

  • Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific, or Manufacturing experience Or

  • Associate’s degree and 8 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific, or Manufacturing experience Or

  • High school diploma / GED and 10 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific, or Manufacturing experience

  • General understanding of biopharmaceutical bulk and drug product development and manufacturing and general knowledge of cGMP’s.

  • Previous experience using VEEVA, Trackwise and other Amgen quality systems.

  • Quality Assurance experience reviewing and approving cGMP documentation (Protocols, Reports, Specifications, SOP’s, etc.).

  • Strong Investigation skills (related to Deviations/CAPAs/EVs) and/or experience owning change control records.

  • Experience with Amgen variation management processes and systems.

  • Experience working on a cross-functional team in a matrix environment and strong project management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including facilitation and presentation skills.

  • Competency in interacting with Senior Management.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple/competing tasks and deliverables.

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

This role oversees adjuster performance, training, workload distribution, and expense management while maintaining strong knowledge of federal and state crop insurance regulations, company policies, and industry standards.

Working closely with Claims Management, Compliance, Marketing, and Underwriting, the Area Claims Supervisor serves as a key escalation point for complex claims and agent concerns and plays an active role in developing talent and supporting business strategies. The position requires frequent travel and the ability to effectively lead and support a remote, field-based team.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Manage, coach, train, and evaluate Crop Insurance Adjusters across Ohio, including conducting performance reviews, succession planning, and day-to-day field support.

  • Oversee claims handling to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with ProAg procedures, federal and state regulations, and RMA standards.

Job Summary

At Level Data, we build the data infrastructure that K-12 education runs on. For twenty years, our platforms have connected the disparate systems inside schools and state agencies - student information, educator credentials, special programs, instructional spend - into a single reliable picture that leaders can act on. Our software supports more than 1,800 districts and 20 state agencies across 48+ states, touching the educational experience of over 7 million students. Our fully remote team of engineers, data specialists, and former educators build products that reduce administrative burden and turn fragmented education data into evidence for smarter decisions.

The Engineering organization delivers the systems state education agencies depend on to manage their educator workforce and oversee the districts they serve. We build at the state level, where a single deployment carries every educator record, every district submission, and every compliance deadline in the state - which means reliability, auditability, and the security of sensitive personnel and student data are engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. Our platforms are how states respond to educator shortages at scale, keep credentialing current as requirements shift, and maintain visibility into district performance.

This role is on the Talent team, which delivers teacher licensure and credentialing, district and school accreditation, statewide teacher evaluation aligned to state frameworks, and talent transparency through our statewide educator job board. The team owns the workflows that move an educator from application to classroom, and the reporting that gives agencies confidence in the quality and completeness of what's underneath.

The Senior Software Engineer will report to the Software Engineering Manager.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the technical standard bearer for the team, setting the quality bar through your own contributions and code reviews and holding the team to it as we scale across new state deployments.
  • Design, build, and own features end to end across a C#/.NET and SQL Server core, extending into React and Node (TypeScript) with Postgres on our newer products.

We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Role Overview

ProAg is looking for a dynamic Area Claims Supervisor to lead and support Crop Insurance Adjusters across Ohio to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant claims handling. This role oversees adjuster performance, training, workload distribution, and expense management while maintaining strong knowledge of federal and state crop insurance regulations, company policies, and industry standards.

Working closely with Claims Management, Compliance, Marketing, and Underwriting, the Area Claims Supervisor serves as a key escalation point for complex claims and agent concerns and plays an active role in developing talent and supporting business strategies. The position requires frequent travel and the ability to effectively lead and support a remote, field-based team.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Manage, coach, train, and evaluate Crop Insurance Adjusters across Ohio, including conducting performance reviews, succession planning, and day-to-day field support.

  • Oversee claims handling to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with ProAg procedures, federal and state regulations, and RMA standards.

  • Assign claims, review and approve work, assist with reserve setting, and serve as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or disputed claims.

  • Partner with Claims Management, Compliance, and Underwriting to support business objectives, resolve field issues, and address regulatory or operational concerns.

  • Monitor Loss Adjuster Expenses (LAE), manage staffing and workload distribution, and adjust claims structure to meet changing market or territory needs

  • Act as a key point of contact for agent inquiries and concerns, ensuring responsive communication and effective issue resolution.

  • Develop and delivery adjuster training, promote best practices, and support the effective use of claims systems and internal tools.

  • Model ProAg’s core values, maintain clear and consistent communication, and uphold professionalism in all internal and external interactions.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in agriculture, a related field, or the equivalent education and/or experience preferred.

  • Current Claim Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) certification

  • A minimum of three years of relevant and progressive crop insurance experience in Claims or Compliance

  • A thorough knowledge of adjusting practices, standard, procedures, and proper use of necessary adjusting equipment

  • Exceptional organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package

  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities

  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement

  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment

  • Basic life and disability insurance

  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match

  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off

  • Paid parental leave

  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription

  • Student loan matching program

  • Employee discount program

  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.

  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.

  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.

  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.

  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.

Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing things.

Job Summary

At Level Data, we build the data infrastructure that K-12 education runs on. For twenty years, our platforms have connected the disparate systems inside schools and state agencies - student information, educator credentials, special programs, instructional spend - into a single reliable picture that leaders can act on. Our software supports more than 1,800 districts and 20 state agencies across 48+ states, touching the educational experience of over 7 million students. Our fully remote team of engineers, data specialists, and former educators build products that reduce administrative burden and turn fragmented education data into evidence for smarter decisions.

The Engineering organization delivers the systems state education agencies depend on to manage their educator workforce and oversee the districts they serve. We build at the state level, where a single deployment carries every educator record, every district submission, and every compliance deadline in the state - which means reliability, auditability, and the security of sensitive personnel and student data are engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. Our platforms are how states respond to educator shortages at scale, keep credentialing current as requirements shift, and maintain visibility into district performance.

This role is on the Talent team, which delivers teacher licensure and credentialing, district and school accreditation, statewide teacher evaluation aligned to state frameworks, and talent transparency through our statewide educator job board. The team owns the workflows that move an educator from application to classroom, and the reporting that gives agencies confidence in the quality and completeness of what's underneath.

The Senior Software Engineer will report to the Software Engineering Manager.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the technical standard bearer for the team, setting the quality bar through your own contributions and code reviews and holding the team to it as we scale across new state deployments.
  • Design, build, and own features end to end across a C#/.NET and SQL Server core, extending into React and Node (TypeScript) with Postgres on our newer products.
  • Break down large or ambiguous technical problems into approachable chunks the team can execute against, partnering with your Product Owner to sequence the work against roadmap commitments and state compliance deadlines.
  • Develop deep knowledge of the team's technical estate, including the integrations that move educator, district, and evaluation data between state systems, and understand how the pieces fit together.
  • Act as a technical resource across the team, unblocking teammates and keeping delivery moving without becoming a bottleneck yourself.
  • Collaborate multi-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and go-to-market partners, hearing customer problems firsthand and bringing an engineering perspective to what we should build, not only how we should build it.
  • Proactively find opportunities for optimization and efficiency across the systems you own, improving availability, performance, and the day-to-day experience of the agencies who depend on them
  • Contribute to estimation and planning, voicing recommendations, feedback, and solutions from a technical perspective and aligning to overall project goals to deliver on time and in scope.
  • Participate fully as a member of a self-managing Scrum team, committing to delivery alongside your teammates and sharing in team responsibilities including production support.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Sustained history of owning a complex codebase, ora track recordof moving effectively between codebases, or a strong balance of the two.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals-algorithms, data structures, and coding fluency-withdemonstrateddepth in a modern web stack.
  • Deep hands-on experience with C# and .NET, including ASP.NET web applications and backend service development.
  • Workingproficiencyin JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front-end framework.
  • Strong relational database skills, including schema designand data modeling inSQL Server,Postgres,or comparable systems.
  • Working knowledge of a major public cloudprovider;we build in Azure, and AWS or Google Cloud experience translates well.
  • Experience delivering at pace in an Agile team environment, including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, and production support.
  • Ability to break down any technical problem into discrete steps as part of a credible solution plan, and to guide teammates toward solutions with questions rather than answers.
  • A collaborator who believes in communal ownership of the work, shares knowledge freely, and helps others rise to the standard they set

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working across both greenfield and legacy codebases, with comfort modernizing systems incrementally rather than by rewrite.
  • Demonstrated history of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team.
  • Experience applying AI/GenAI tooling to increase development and support efficiency.
  • Above-average written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to a Product Owner or a customer without flattening it or burying them in it.
  • Genuine curiosity about the customer's problem and the business behind it, and a desire to work closely with the people closest to both.

Job Description:

Job Title: Category Manager - Professional Services

Location: Remote Home Office - North America

Reports to: Head of Procurement

Role Summary

The Category Manager for Professional Services will report to the Head of Procurement. The role will have key responsibility for strategic sourcing, vendor management, and contract negotiations across all talent-related categories at JD Power. These categories include consultants, contract labor, staff augmentation resources, and professional services engagements across all business functions and geographies.

This role involves identifying and prioritizing organizational needs, understanding the talent and services market, developing and executing sourcing strategies, leading competitive procurement processes, and negotiating favorable commercial terms. The successful candidate will work closely with business leaders, the Legal and Finance teams, and external supplier partners to ensure JD Power retains top-tier services while optimizing costs and managing risk. Excellence in communication, relationship management, and strategic thinking are essential to success in this position.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and execute comprehensive sourcing and category management strategies for consultants, contract labor, staff augmentation, professional services, and related category spend across the organization
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers and staffing partners to understand capabilities, market rates, and emerging talent trends
  • Partner with business stakeholders across all departments to understand talent needs, skill requirements, project timelines, and budget constraints
  • Conduct market research and benchmarking to establish baselines, identify best practices, and stay informed of industry trends in talent sourcing and professional services
  • Lead procurement activities including RFx processes, vendor selection, rate negotiations, and contract finalization
  • Manage contract negotiations with vendors and service providers, ensuring favorable terms, compliance with company policies, and alignment with risk and legal requirements
  • Collaborate with Legal and Finance to manage onboarding, contracting, compliance, and invoicing for all talent and professional services providers
  • Drive cost optimization and value creation by identifying savings opportunities, managing spend, negotiating favorable rates, and delivering measurable ROI
  • Manage supplier performance through regular business reviews, quality assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Develop business cases and presentations for sourcing decisions, cost savings initiatives, and vendor recommendations to secure stakeholder buy-in
  • Maintain deep category knowledge of staffing markets, professional services ecosystems, and talent management best practices
  • Monitor and report on key metrics including spend, headcount, savings, vendor performance, and compliance across all talent categories

Key Relationships

  • Internal: Business unit leaders, department heads, HR, Finance, Legal, and IT teams across the organization
  • External: Staffing agencies, consultants, contractors, professional services firms, and other talent providers
  • Cross-functional: Procurement team members, category managers, and sourcing specialists

What You Will Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 8+ years of strategic sourcing, category management, or procurement experience
  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience managing talent categories (staffing, consulting, professional services, or contract labor)
  • Proven track record of cost savings, contract negotiations, and vendor relationship management
  • Deep knowledge of staffing markets, talent ecosystems, and professional services industries
  • Understanding of HR processes, compliance requirements (W-2, 1099, visa sponsorship), and employment law implications

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with ability to influence at all levels
  • Proficiency with procurement systems, data analysis tools, and Microsoft Office
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
  • Strong relationship and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment across geographies and time zones

Personal Attributes

  • Results-oriented with demonstrated track record of measurable business impact
  • Resourceful and entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable driving projects with limited resources
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functions and cultural backgrounds
  • Strong work ethic with sense of urgency to move initiatives to completion

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, HR, or related field; or equivalent professional experience

Special Conditions

  • Occasional travel may be required to meet with vendors, clients, and internal stakeholders
  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the position is based. JD Power will not sponsor visa applications for this position

This position has a starting salary range of $96,000 - $160,000 USD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday

The position is fully remote with the option of working from our premises in Athens, Crete or Thessaloniki.

Main Responsibilities and Tasks

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and Jenkins (YAML pipelines, Jenkinsfile, shared libraries) from commit to production;
  • Manage and scale Kubernetes clusters on AKS across dev, staging, and production; author Helm charts; manage namespaces, RBAC, configmaps, secrets, and ingress;
  • Provision and version infrastructure with Terraform/Bicep and manage configuration with Ansible across multiple Azure environments;
  • Enforce security gates in pipelines — Trivy container scans, Checkov IaC policies, SonarQube SAST quality gates; manage secrets via HashiCorp Vault and Azure Key Vault;
  • Own observability — Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, ELK/OpenSearch log aggregation, OpenTelemetry instrumentation; define and track SLOs and error budgets;
  • Manage network configuration — DNS, VPN, ingress controllers, load balancers, and network policies; lead blameless post-mortems.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or equivalent demonstrable experience;
  • 3+ years of hands-on DevOps, Build & Release, or Cloud Engineering experience in production;
  • Deep hands-on Azure: VMs, VNets, Storage, Azure AD, Load Balancers, AKS; Kubernetes day-2 operations; Docker image build, publish, and hardening;
  • Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines, repos, artifacts, agent pools, branching policies) and Jenkins (Jenkinsfile, shared libraries); Git workflows (GitFlow or trunk-based);
  • Terraform for infrastructure-as-code and Ansible for configuration management (playbooks, roles, inventories);
  • Trivy, Checkov, and SonarQube as blocking pipeline gates; secrets management with HashiCorp Vault or Azure Key Vault;
  • Scripting in Python and/or Bash/PowerShell; Prometheus + Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch; networking fundamentals (DNS, VPN, ingress, load balancers, network policies); English B2+.

Desired Qualifications

  • Certifications: AZ-400, AZ-104 or AZ-305, CKA. Experience with GitHub Actions, Kustomize/advanced Helm, Bicep/ARM, OpenTelemetry, APM tooling (Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), Nginx Ingress, cert-manager, external-dns.
  • Multi-cloud exposure (AWS); database operations in pipelines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis); message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka); high-availability, multi-region, or regulated-industry infrastructure.

  • Private Health Coverage on the Company’s group program;
  • Flexible Working Hours;

  • Professional Development: Benefit from language courses, specialized training, and continuous learning opportunities;
  • Career Growth: Work with some of the most innovative and exciting specialists in the industry;
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a setting that offers challenging goals, autonomy, and mentoring, fostering both personal and company growth.

If you want an exciting challenge, work with some of the coolest technologies, and enjoy your time doing it, then join us! Submit your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (ADE1/08/26).

You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our website () and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn.

NAMSA pioneered the industry and was the first independent company in the world to focus solely on medical device materials for safety. NAMSA started testing medical devices before the U.S. Food and Drug Administration started regulating such products in 1976.

We are shaping the industry. NAMSA has been a key contributor to the development of the test methods that govern our industry. We have become the industry’s premier provider. We provide support for clients during every step of the product development lifecycle and beyond.

Come and work for an organization with the:

Vision to inspire innovative MedTech solutions that advance global healthcare, improve patient lives and accelerate Client success and the

Mission to deliver best-in-class global MedTech development solutions through our people, expertise and technology by adhering to our core

Values:

  • Act with integrity in everything we do.
  • Provide best-in-class customer experiences.
  • Develop superior talent and deliver expertise.
  • Respond with agility and provide timely results.
  • Embrace collaboration, diverse perspectives and ideas.

Compensation Target:


$75,000.00

Job Description:

•Actively works to promote operational excellence by monitoring and improving processes related to management of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) (including Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events and Device Deficiencies/Events), Clinical Events Committees (CECs), and Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs).
•Performs intake, review, analysis, and data entry of ICSRs into tracking system, regulatory report, and/or Safety database. Writes ICSR narratives. Interprets reported event information, including medical conditions, laboratory results, and medical procedures. Correctly determines relevant follow-up data required for ICSR completion. Distributes notifications of ICSR to study team/Sponsor including case triage and submission requirements. Participates in ICSR reconciliation between Clinical database and Safety database as required. Utilizes MedDRA dictionary for term coding.
•Provides content for the ongoing development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, guidelines, templates, and training materials for Safety department.
•Independently establishes work priorities with minimal input from Management.
•Maintains tracking tools for departmental key performance/quality indicator metrics.
•Meets key performance indicators and quality targets established by Management.
•Attends study team meetings and company staff meetings, providing status updates and tracking action items as needed.
•Assists in quality assurance activities including audits.
•Develops and/or maintains knowledge of current Good Clinical Practices, Good Vigilance Practices, Safety best writing practices, and data entry conventions.
•Serves as mentor and coach to less experienced Safety team members and non-Safety staff.
•Co-Authors study-specific Safety project documents (Safety Plans, CEC Charters, DMC Charters, etc.) based on clinical study protocol details and contracted Safety services. Ensures compliance with these documents.
•Maintains solid knowledge of study protocol sections pertaining to Safety services.
•Participates in the design, testing, and/or ongoing maintenance/use of electronic systems that aide in the execution of CEC, AE Reporting, and other Safety services.

raw.description:
About the Company

Our client is a US-based mortgage company operating across multiple states, with a full-service team handling everything from initial borrower consultation through loan origination, processing, underwriting, and closing. As they scale, they are hiring a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own paid media and lead generation from strategy through execution.

You will report directly to the Founder/CEO and be the single accountable owner of Google and Meta performance — high-budget campaigns, tightly tracked, ruthlessly optimized against cost per qualified lead. This is a senior, execution-heavy seat. You build strategy from scratch, launch campaigns from zero, and drive CPL down through disciplined experimentation.

If you have generated real mortgage leads — or leads for a comparable high-ticket financial product such as refinancing, home equity, or personal lending — at real CPLs on real budgets, and you can talk through your numbers without a deck to hide behind, we want to see your application.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Execution — Google & Meta

This is the core of the role.

  • Own the full Google Ads strategy and execution across search, display, Local Service Ads, and Performance Max, focused on high-intent mortgage leads — purchase, refinance, and home equity borrowers
  • Own the full Meta Ads strategy and execution across Facebook and Instagram, including prospecting campaigns, retargeting funnels, and structured creative testing
  • Build, launch, and continuously optimize campaigns from the ground up — not simply manage what already exists
  • Write brief, compelling ad copy and creative direction tailored to the mortgage borrower at each stage of awareness
  • Manage campaign budgets efficiently, allocating spend across channels to maximize cost per qualified lead

Lead Generation & Pipeline Quality

  • Drive consistent, high-quality inbound mortgage leads to fuel the loan officer pipeline
  • Define, track, and optimize against lead quality metrics — leads that convert to consultations and funded loans, not just raw form-fills
  • Build and optimize landing pages and conversion funnels to maximize lead capture from paid traffic
  • Coordinate with the sales and loan officer team to bring lead quality feedback back into targeting, audience, and creative strategy
  • Understand mortgage borrower intent signals and use them to sharpen audience targeting and messaging

Marketing Strategy

  • Develop an integrated digital marketing strategy connecting paid search, paid social, and supporting channels into a single cohesive lead generation engine
  • Identify new channels, audiences, and tactics to reduce dependence on any one traffic source
  • Stay current on mortgage industry marketing trends, competitor activity, regulatory advertising requirements, and platform algorithm changes
  • Bring data-driven recommendations to leadership on budget, channel mix, and growth opportunities

Analytics & Reporting

  • Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and CRM integration
  • Deliver clear, actionable performance reports covering spend, impressions, clicks, leads, CPL, and lead-to-close rates
  • Use data to identify what is working, what is not, and what to do next — and act on it without being asked
  • Proactively keep leadership informed on campaign performance on a consistent rhythm

Creative & Messaging

  • Develop ad creative, copy, and landing page content that speaks credibly and compellingly to the mortgage borrower audience — purchase buyers, refinance candidates, and home equity seekers
  • Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on headlines, visuals, offers, and CTAs
  • Ensure all messaging is fully compliant with platform policies, RESPA, TILA, and applicable mortgage advertising regulations — compliance is non-negotiable in this industry

Requirements

  • 5 or more years of hands-on paid media experience with a strong focus on Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Demonstrated track record of generating mortgage leads, financial services leads, or high-ticket consumer leads at scale — mortgage and lending experience preferred; real estate, insurance, or comparable financial products accepted
  • Expert-level Google Ads proficiency across search, Local Service Ads, Performance Max, and smart bidding strategies
  • Expert-level Meta Ads proficiency including campaign structure, audience building, retargeting, creative testing, and iOS 14+ tracking workarounds (CAPI, aggregated event measurement)
  • Strong analytical skills — you make decisions from data, not instinct alone
  • Experience with conversion tracking setup including GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel/CAPI, and CRM attribution
  • Ability to manage significant monthly ad budgets with direct accountability for CPL and ROI
  • Self-directed remote worker with direct accountability to leadership
  • Professional written English suitable for CEO-facing reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct mortgage industry marketing experience — borrower psychology, rate-sensitivity cycles, seasonal demand patterns, and common objections
  • Familiarity with mortgage compliance requirements for advertising — RESPA, TILA, NMLS disclosure requirements, and Fair Lending considerations
  • Landing page builder experience — Unbounce, Leadpages, or ClickFunnels
  • CRM familiarity for lead tracking and attribution — HubSpot, Salesforce, or a mortgage-specific CRM such as Velocify or Total Expert
  • Experience running geo-targeted and local campaigns for a multi-market lending or financial services company
  • Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications

Tools & Software

Primary Paid Platforms

  • Google Ads — Search, Display, LSA, Performance Max
  • Meta Ads Manager — Facebook and Instagram

Tracking & Analytics

• GA4 and Google Tag Manager

  • Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI)

Landing Pages & CRO

  • Unbounce, Leadpages, or ClickFunnels

CRM & Attribution

  • HubSpot, Salesforce, or mortgage-specific CRM platform

Reporting

  • Looker Studio, Excel, or Google Sheets

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have run campaigns that generated real mortgage or financial services leads at a real CPL, and you can walk through the numbers in a conversation
  • You do not wait to be told what to test next — you look at the data, form a hypothesis, and run the experiment
  • Your campaigns are structured cleanly, tracked accurately, and reported on clearly without anyone chasing you
  • You are as comfortable building from scratch as diagnosing an underperforming account
  • You understand that in mortgage, lead quality and compliance matter as much as volume — and you optimize for all three
  • You proactively keep leadership informed on a consistent rhythm

Requirements

What We Offer

• Compensation up to $12 per hour

• 100% remote work

• Full-time role

Their founding team (CEO, CSO, CMO, and CMO) came together around a shared commitment: to enable everyday people to access clean, high quality supplements with transparent ingredients based on the latest scientific insights in rapidly growing field of longevity.

Working with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and researchers from institutions, our client has grown its product range to 12 supplements supporting cellular health, skin, sleep, joints, metabolism, and gut health.

Our client takes great care in selecting only high quality ingredients from reputable sources and in a rare move for the supplement industry transparently publishes the supplier of each ingredient used on its website. All supplements are also double tested for purity and against contamination in an independent 3d party lab in Switzerland.

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Influencer & Partnerships Manager to take a lead role within their Partnerships Team. You will be an integral driver of our client’s partnership program, with the autonomy to shape their strategy in the dynamic global markets. You will lead the charge in establishing and nurturing high-impact relationships to elevate our brand’s global presence.

LOCATION:Remote – must live in or near Alamance, Granville, Franklin, or Vance County, NC. The person in this role must maintain residency in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the North Carolina border.Must have ability to travel to Vaya Partners offices as needed.

GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB

This position develops and maintains collaboration among local agencies, community stakeholders, advocacy groups and political units, such as County Managers and Boards of Commissioners. The position serves as a collaborative partner in identifying system barriers, developing solutions, and leading related efforts in the assigned communities. This position works with other Vaya departments to address identified needs within the region.

Note: This position requires access to and use of confidential healthcare information or protected health information (PHI) as described in laws addressing patient confidentiality, including, but not limited to, the federal HIPAA law, the Confidentiality of Alcohol and Substance Abuse Patient Records law, 42 CFR Part 2, and various state laws. As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Health. The individual filling this position shall also sign a confidentiality statement as an employee of Vaya Health.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Community Relations:

Represents Vaya and fulfills the MCO’s role in meeting community stakeholder needs by serving on related community boards and agency committees. Examples include, but are not limited to, regular meetings with Health Department, DSS, school system, DJJ, law enforcement leadership personnel, County Managers, County Boards of Commissioners, and other designated Vaya stakeholder groups or individuals. Responds to inquiries and concerns from agencies and stakeholders by resolving the issues or identifying other Vaya departments to assist. Educates and informs community agencies and boards about MCO functions, resources, and provider capacity. Strives to address barriers that prevent members or other stakeholders from achieving full participation in their communities; offers related recommendations to MCO Management Team for direction when items of concern are identified and require resolution. Independently identifies and intervenes to offer solutions to issues between local stakeholders and the MCO.

Training and Support of Staff:

The Community Relations Regional Director empowers Vaya members and their communities to identify needs, employ community resources (as feasible), and generate local solutions to help bridge healthcare gaps. In developing each community’s capacity to address existing health disparities team members foster collaborative relations and promote effective partnerships among stakeholders. Such partnerships among stakeholders. Such partnerships support community engagement and serve as the foundation for developing community-driven approaches to addressing healthcare needs.

Vaya Health Leadership Member:

Participates as a member of Vaya’s Leadership in making decisions and providing leadership to the agency. Represents the needs and issues of their assigned counties (4 to 7 counties) to Vaya Leadership, and keeps the team informed of issues for the region. This position represents Vaya Health in many venues in their assigned region such as County Board of Commissioners, local providers, and agencies. This person also provides regional input into the UM State Plan for their region and any initiatives or projects in the region.

Other duties as assigned by the Community Relations Vice President.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

A high level of diplomacy and discretion is required to effectively negotiate and resolve issues. This will require exceptional interpersonal skills, highly effective communication ability, and the propensity to make prompt independent decisions based upon relevant facts. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills are essential. Demonstrate effective leadership presence required, with demonstrated confidence in dealing with unknown and complex issues. Awareness of and sensitivity to local political issues.

In the Community Relations Regional Director role, the employee must have knowledge of mental health, developmental disabilities and substance abuse services systems and evidence-based practices and programs. The employee must have a willingness to become proficient in all disability areas, including areas where co-occurring illnesses exist. This is a high-profile community position and as such, the person must be well spoken and able to quickly establish rapport, credibility, and rapport with others, as well as communicate clearly and effectively. A core requirement of this position is to build string relationships between Vaya Health and each community.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in public service administration, psychology, social work, education, health, business administration or related human service field.

  • Three years of experience in human services or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

Preferred work experience:

  • Experience in any of the following areas would be valuable for this employee: Public speaking, presentation development, group facilitation, advocacy, regulations compliance and project management.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as preparation and analysis of documents; viewing a computer terminal; and extensive reading.
  • Physical activity in this position includes crouching, reaching, walking, talking, hearing and repetitive motion of hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Sedentary work with lifting requirements up to 10 pounds, sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Mental concentration is required in all aspects of work.
  • Must be able to multi-task and prioritize.

RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT:The person in this position is required to reside in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the North Carolina border.

SALARY:Depending on qualifications & experience of candidate. This position is exempt and is not eligible for overtime compensation.

POSITION TITLE:Program Manager, Environmental and Climate Justice

SUPERVISOR:Director, Center for Environmental and Climate Justice

DATE EFFECTIVE:August 18, 2026

DATE REVISED:August 18, 2026

LOCATION:Washington, D.C., Remote

TRAVEL: Moderate

JOB CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

The NAACP Empowerment Programs, Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization for equal rights, seeks a Program Manager, Environmental and Climate Justice, who is a dynamic and innovative leader who has a foundational understanding of environmental and climate justice issues, can produce high-quality written work, gather and translate research and information for internal and external audiences and contribute to the overall strategic direction of the Association.

TheCenter for Environmental and Climate Justiceis one of the Centers of Innovation (C-HOPE) at the NAACP. The Center’s team of subject matter experts work with our robust national network of member units and their local communities to execute transformative strategies. The Center proactively disrupts the inequitable systems that disproportionately impact Black Americans. The Center responds to environmental and climate justice issues leveraging change levers through a comprehensive, multi-stakeholder advocacy approach.

The Program manager is a key member of the team, who assists in tracking and managing environmental and climate justice issues as outlined in the Center’s priority areas of work. Additionally, program manager is the day-to-day operational lead for administrative needs within the Center.

The ideal candidate has the capacity to work with the Director for the Center for Environmental and Climate Justice to carry out the goals within the Center and how the NAACP can address rapidly evolving challenges in the field. The ideal candidate has expertise in and knowledge of environmental and climate justice issues as well as complex short-term and long-term project management and campaigns. Attention to detail in work product, an ability to problem solve and think critically, and a high level of emotional intelligence is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES

Under the direction of the Director, Environmental Climate and Justice, the Program Manager will perform the following duties, to include, but not limited to:

  • Contribute to the implementation of a strategic portfolio of work.
  • Establish and maintain processes for managing campaigns, initiatives, and projects.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans including scope, objectives, and timelines;coordinate internal and external resources to ensure projects adhere to schedule and budget.
  • Ensure responsive and effective communication internally and externally to partners.
  • Develop resources, letters, presentations, and other materials.
  • Manage and coordinate team, committee, speaking engagements, conferences, and other meetings.
  • Foster, cultivate, organize, and host small to large scale virtual and in-person meetings that maintain and expand the Center for Environmental and Climate Justice’s network.
  • Track multi-year program initiatives in accordance with expected outcomes and financial performance.
  • Track and draft administrative and operations reports, briefs, documents.
  • Coordinate reporting functions and track key metrics and outcomes of the team’s grant-funded and other work.
  • Draft reports, internal and external memoranda, briefs, public comments, and other written communications to various audiences
  • Serve as the liaison to teams and audiences, providing representation where appropriate.
  • Leverage appropriate tools to ensure efficiencies and quality of work.
  • Deliver high quality, timely work product.
  • Think strategically, anticipate challenges, envision growth, reflect thoughtfully, and embrace change.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by the Director, Center for Environmental and Climate Justice or other designee.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Minimum of three to five years’ experience in program/project management or related field; experience in non-profit, policy, advocacy, or other civil rights organizations preferred.
  • Knowledge of environmental and climate justice issues.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification preferred.
  • Six Sigma Certification preferred.
  • Practical experience with Lean or Six Sigma methodologies preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading small- and large-scale projects.
  • Experience in a fast-paced highly dynamic, evolving organization and work environment in a national, academic, or nonprofit organization program management position.
  • Effective communication skills including exceptional written and verbal skills, excellent people skills, and strong relationship-building skills with an ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Public speaking skills and ability to create and deliver presentations before high-profile audiences.
  • Strong execution, analytical and organizational skills and demonstrated experience in prioritizing and executing multiple priorities, programs, and projects seamlessly with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated abilities in planning meetings and large events, writing, organizing, and training skills.
  • Demonstrated strong proactive problem-solving skills with strong decision-making capability.
  • Work effectively both independently, as well as, in a team-oriented, collaborative, and collegial environment; and
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite, Outlook, and related Project Management Software.

raw.description:
Tech Lead & Product Engineer (Internal Platforms)

The Opportunity

We’re looking to bring on a full-time Tech Lead & Product Engineer to take ownership of our internal reporting dashboard and drive its evolution into a comprehensive operational platform. This is a unique hybrid role designed for a highly skilled engineer who loves writing production code but also excels at coordinating developer workflows and shaping product strategy.

In this role, you will act as the technical anchor and delivery manager for our dashboard system, which currently pulls marketing data from Meta, GA4, and other sources to automate client reporting. While you will remain deeply hands-on in the codebase, you will also be responsible for translating high-level business goals into a structured product timeline, managing sprint schedules, and unblocking the development team.

Crucially, this role focuses entirely on technical execution, product scoping, and timeline delivery; it does not carry corporate HR burdens like hiring, firing, or formal performance reviews. You will have full ownership over the code and the schedule, serving as the critical bridge between business vision and engineering execution.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Code Management

  • Maintain and architect core systems for the live internal reporting dashboard and future platform extensions.
  • Ensure code quality and maintainability by setting engineering standards and leading pull request reviews.
  • Mentor team members, distribute technical tasks, and actively unblock developers to keep execution smooth.

Product Strategy & Timeline Ownership

  • Guide the product roadmap timeline, translating business objectives into clear, phased engineering milestones.
  • Lead sprint and release planning, carefully balancing technical debt, background optimization, and new feature rollouts.
  • Collaborate directly with product leadership to define feature scopes, requirements, and technical boundaries.

Hands-on Development

  • Build new user-facing features like saved reports, PDF export, email scheduling, and widget customization.
  • Integrate and maintain external data pipelines (Meta Ads, GA4, Google Ads) while ensuring robust metrics normalization and caching.
  • Optimize scheduling logic (cron), async background jobs, and queueing architectures for heavy data processing workflows.
  • Lead the upcoming expansion into broader operational modules (content approvals, automated onboarding workflows, and client self-serve portals, AI).

Skills Required

Frontend

  • React 19 + Next.js (App Router)
  • TailwindCSS, Zustand, React Query
  • Component systems (Radix UI, shadcn/ui)
  • Responsive layout, drag-and-drop UI, animation polish

Backend & Infrastructure

  • Node.js API routes with TypeScript
  • Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL (hosted on Neon)
  • Background jobs (cron, ioredis), Redis queues
  • In-house session-based auth and role access logic
  • Third-party API management (Meta, GA4, Google Ads) including token refresh and retry logic
  • Vercel for hosting, Redis for async processing
  • PDF generation (puppeteer-core, sharp) and email delivery via Resend
  • AWS S3 SDK integration for secure uploads
  • Strong AI skillset

Workflow & Leadership

  • Outstanding communication skills in async environments, with an ability to manage timelines without micromanagement.
  • Exceptional structural alignment—proven capability to balance deep-work coding slots with active project planning.
  • Uses modern AI tools (Copilot, GPT) strategically to accelerate engineering output and debug complex workflows.
  • Writes exceptionally clean, modular, and self-documenting code.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience transitioning from senior engineering into a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or Technical Product Owner role.
  • Experience architecting internal administrative dashboards, agency operations tooling, or multi-tenant reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing metrics, attribution logic, or social analytics.
  • Comfort operating in an autonomous, fast-moving early-stage team environment.

Requirements

This is a full time role

Rate starts at $12/hr

100% Remote Work

Headquartered in Irvine, California, EBizCharge specializes in developing integrated payment solutions that facilitate electronic payment processing within ERP, CRM, Mobile, and eCommerce applications. Our applications are PCI compliant and fully integrated with major ERP/accounting systems, including QuickBooks, Sage, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Epicor, Acumatica, and major online shopping carts, including Magento and WooCommerce. EBizCharge offers its employees tremendous learning opportunities, career growth potential, and a dynamic work environment.

We are seeking a Software Engineer II to join our growing team. This role is focused on building and supporting secure payment solutions across EMV terminals, backend services, and integrations. The ideal candidate has experience working on payment systems or processor integrations and is interested in deepening their expertise in EMV certification, tokenization, and end-to-end transaction flows. This engineer will collaborate closely with senior team members to deliver reliable, compliant, and scalable payment solutions.

Responsibilities

EMV Terminal & Device Development

  • Develop and maintain Ingenico terminal applications using Kotlin and Ingenico SDK
  • Implement EMV transaction flows (contact, contactless, NFC, wallet)
  • Integrate terminal software with host systems and gateway APIs
  • Troubleshoot device-level issues, EMV kernel interactions, and transaction failures
  • Assist with firmware updates and terminal configuration management

Backend Payment Services (.NET)

  • Contribute to the development of secure RESTful APIs using .NET/ASPE.NET core
  • Implement core payment workflows: authorization, capture, refund, void, and settlement
  • Support integrations with payment processors and gateways
  • Build and maintain device management services (registration, monitoring, configuration)
  • Implement webhook listeners and event-driven payment updates
  • Support batch settlement, reconciliation, and reporting processes
  • Participate in production troubleshooting and reliability improvements

EMV Certification & Processor Integration

  • Contribute to EMV Level 3 certification efforts by executing test cases and validating transaction flows
  • Assist in validating host message formatting and transaction responses
  • Troubleshoot processor-level declines and edge cases with guidance from senior engineers
  • Support regression testing and re-certification activities
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external processors during certification cycles

Tokenization & Wallet Integration

  • Support implementation of network tokenization flows (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)
  • Assist with token lifecycle management (provisioning, updates, de-tokenization)
  • Support integrations for Apple Pay and Google Pay
  • Ensure payment flows adhere to card network and security requirements

Mobile Payment Integration

  • Support Android-based mobile payment integrations using Kotlin
  • Integrate payment SDKs and troubleshoot mobile transaction issues
  • Assist with mobile wallet provisioning and transaction flows

Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional software development experience
  • Experience working on payment systems, financial systems, or API integrations
