raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Non-Solicitation Policy and Notice to Agencies and Recruiters:

IDEAYA's Non-Solicitation Policy strictly prohibits agencies and recruiters from any contact and communication with IDEAYA employees, managers, and leaders to submit unsolicited candidate resumes and/or to solicit business partnerships. Submission of unsolicited candidate resumes by agencies or recruiters with or without a contract in place with IDEAYA Biosciences Inc. will not create any implied obligation. Failure to comply with this policy will result in disqualification from current and future business opportunities with IDEAYA Biosciences. All recruiting and talent agency decisions are strictly managed by the internal IDEAYA Human Resources function. All communication by external agencies and recruiters must be directed to . We ask that you only email your interest once.

Job Summary

About IDEAYA Biosciences:
IDEAYA is a precision medicine oncology company committed to the discovery, development, and commercialization of transformative therapies for cancer. Our approach integrates expertise in small-molecule drug discovery, structural biology and bioinformatics with robust internal capabilities in identifying and validating translational biomarkers to develop tailored, potentially first-in-class targeted therapies aligned to the genetic drivers of disease. We have built a deep pipeline of product candidates focused on synthetic lethality and antibody-drug conjugates, or ADCs, for molecularly defined solid tumor indications. Our mission is to bring forth the next wave of precision oncology therapies that are more selective, more effective, and deeply personalized with the goal of altering the course of disease and improving clinical outcomes for patients with cancer.

When you're at IDEAYA, you will be in the midst of brilliant minds working on precision medicine therapies to help cancer patients. We are passionate and committed about being on the forefront of oncology medicine, which means we all have a high internal drive that is at the very core of every person at IDEAYA. We are inquisitive, ask deep questions, and are data-driven innovators who like to collaborate and use team work to move science forward. For more information, please see www.ideayabio.com.

Location: Prefer candidates in Miami, Florida, but willing to consider candidates in Orlando, Florida.
*Territory coverage includes geography in the following states: Florida and Puerto Rico*

Position Summary:

IDEAYA is seeking Senior Oncology Account Managers (OAM) to join our Commercial team. The Senior Oncology Account Manager [OAM] serves as a strategic territory leader within a designated geographic region with responsibility for leading the launch and adoption of darovasertib within their assigned geography. The individual will act as a key conduit of clinical, scientific, and market intelligence related to darovasertib in uveal melanoma.

This role blends advanced scientific acumen with sophisticated account leadership to drive appropriate awareness and adoption within complex academic, community, and referral-based ecosystems. The Senior OAM operates with a high degree of autonomy, managing the most strategically important accounts and serving as a trusted partner to multidisciplinary healthcare stakeholders across the treatment landscape.

Through disciplined planning and enterprise collaboration, the Senior OAM builds durable relationships, activates referral pathways, and contributes meaningfully to regional and national commercial strategy. They will effectively balance outstanding execution in targeted, high-volume accounts with the need to ensure every patient can be considered for a new therapeutic option. The Senior OAM consistently adheres to internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining deep expertise in disease state management, evolving clinical data, the product package insert, and access considerations.

The Senior Oncology Account Manager reports to the Regional Business Director. This is a field-based role.


Reporting to: Senior Regional Business Director

Job Description

What you’ll do:

  • Demonstrate and maintain advanced knowledge of uveal melanoma, tumor biology, emerging clinical data, the competitive environment, and darovasertib's mechanism of action
  • Independently develop and execute sophisticated territory and ecosystem-level account strategies to drive appropriate product utilization
  • Leverage scientific knowledge and executive presence to cultivate peer-level relationships with leading academic oncologists, ocular specialists, and multidisciplinary stakeholders
  • Translate complex clinical data into clear, compliant, and compelling product education tailored to each stakeholder
  • Execute pre-launch and launch strategies in alignment with national brand objectives
  • Identify, activate, and optimize referral networks across the patient journey
  • Partner strategically with Medical Affairs, Value & Access, and Patient Services to optimally support complex accounts
  • Act as the voice of the customer, delivering actionable insights to key internal stakeholders informing brand strategy, lifecycle planning, and future launch readiness.
  • Effectively utilize multiple sources of analytics and performance data to optimize resource deployment and account prioritization and adapt execution plans accordingly
  • Adherence to all administrative requirements, including budget management, expense report management, CRM call reporting and synchronization, etc., within required timelines and company guidelines
  • Ensure all promotional activities adhere to regulatory and ethical standards
  • Travel: ~80%

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, biological sciences, or related discipline
  • Minimum 10 years pharmaceutical sales related experience; minimum 5+ years oncology sales experience
  • Proven success launching a first-in-class or specialty oncology product in the US
  • Experience in rare disease, orphan oncology, or highly specialized markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in high-level scientific dialogue with academic healthcare professionals
  • Possess comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process and fulfillment pathways for oral oncolytics and ability to partner internally and externally to support patient access to IDEAYA’s therapies.
  • Proven track record managing complex, high-impact academic and community oncology accounts
  • Strong analytic, strategic planning, and organizational skills
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and professionalism
  • Patient-centric mindset grounded in integrity and scientific rigor
  • Overnight travel corresponding to territory size and needs, including occasional evening and weekend work for conferences
  • Residence within assigned geographic region

Core Competencies

  • Scientific Credibility: Comfortable discussing complex mechanisms of action, clinical endpoints, and patient needs in an accessible and differentiated way
  • Complex Selling Capability: Skilled at multi-stakeholder engagement in a complex disease state
  • Collaboration: Thrives in cross-functional partnership within a lean organization
  • Analytical Rigor: Uses data to drive prioritization and resource allocation
  • Patient-Centric Mindset: Keeps patient needs at the heart of every decision
  • Execution Excellence: Delivers results with urgency, agility, quality, and compliance

All employees are expected to act with integrity and in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and IDEAYA policies, including IDEAYA’s Code of Conduct.

Employees must demonstrate good judgement and ethical behavior in all business activities, maintain patient and product safety as a top priority, and report any suspected violations of law or Company policy through appropriate channels

Total Rewards

Along with our inspiring mission, and highly collaborative and inclusive environment, IDEAYA offers a competitive total rewards package that reflects our pay-for-performance philosophy where employees are eligible to be considered for merit-based salary increases, company discretionary short-term incentive plan participation, and company discretionary stock option awards (based on board approval). Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but is not limited to, medical/dental/vision coverage (100% company paid for employees and 90% company paid for dependents), 401k, ESPP, and wellness programs.

The expected salary range for the role of Senior Oncology Account Manager is $187,000 - $231,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors that may include but are not limited to the office location where this open position is located, the final candidates’ experience within their profession, experience in the disease areas we are striving to make an impact in as a company, length of time within the industry, educational background, and performance during the interview process.

The Company complies with all laws respecting equal employment opportunities and does not discriminate against applicants with regard to any protected characteristic as defined by federal, state, and local law. This position requires you to work onsite in the office at the Company’s facilities for training & meetings, with work-from-home flexibility, and the Company requires that all employees working in its facilities be fully vaccinated (except as required by applicable law). Therefore, this position requires you to be fully vaccinated from COVID-19, subject to reasonable accommodations for medical or religious reasons, and/or as otherwise required by applicable law. The Company considers you fully vaccinated once 14 days have passed since you received either the second dose in a two-dose COVID-19 vaccine series or a single-dose COVID-19 vaccine. The vaccine must have been FDA approved, have emergency use authorization from the FDA, or, for persons fully vaccinated outside of the U.S., be listed for emergency use by the World Health Organization.

IDEAYA is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, IDEAYA does not discriminate in hiring or otherwise in employment based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. EOE/AA/Vets.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Vice President, API Technologies is a senior leader in the Chief Technology Office accountable for the strategy, product management, engineering, governance, modernization, and reliable operation of Humana’s enterprise API and integration ecosystem, spanning internal APIs, external partner and ecosystem APIs, and the shared platforms that enable them. As a dedicated enterprise function, this role leads APIs capabilities end to end, from standards, product strategy, the Unified API Gateway, and the Unified API Catalog through the enterprise-wide shift to a consumer-centric Omnichannel API model that delivers consistent, secure experiences across member, provider, associate, and partner touchpoints.
This leader runs APIs as products, treating API producers and consumers, internal and external, as customers. The VP owns the API product roadmap, lifecycle, investment priorities, adoption, reuse, health, and consumer experience. The VP is directly accountable for defining and creating Omnichannel APIs and for governing the modernization journey that migrates producers and consumers to modern, enterprise-aligned interfaces, while retiring redundant APIs, unsupported gateways, and legacy integration technologies.
The role also owns Humana’s external API strategy, including the secure exposure of APIs to partners and the broader ecosystem, technical management of API-enabled partnerships, partner certification and onboarding, and the heightened security, privacy, interoperability, support, and continuity requirements of external interfaces.
This is an AI-native function. The VP embeds AI into API design, delivery, governance, testing, and consumer migration, and establishes the enterprise approach for safely exposing approved API capabilities to AI agents through MCP and other emerging agent protocols where appropriate. The role is a primary enabler of interoperability, automation, resilient partner growth, and Humana’s 2030 Target State Architecture.

Scope of Accountability

- API Product Strategy & Management

API-as-a-product operating model, including product vision, roadmap, investment, adoption, reuse, consumer experience, value realization, and health metrics.

- API Standards, Governance & Security

Enterprise standards for REST, GraphQL, asynchronous messaging, event-driven APIs, and emerging protocols; full lifecycle governance; UAG and UAC; quality engineering; and API security in partnership with EIP.

- Omnichannel API Definition & Creation

Definition, design, and build of consumer-centric Omnichannel APIs aligned to consumer journeys and providing governed, consistent access to authoritative capabilities and data across channels.

- API Modernization: Producers & Consumers

Migration of producers and validated active consumers from legacy and point APIs to modern enterprise interfaces, including deprecation, retirement, dependency management, and progress reporting.

- External APIs, Partnerships & Governance

External API strategy, secure exposure, technical partnership management, certification, developer experience, data-use controls, interoperability compliance, continuity, and third-party API consumption.

- AI-Enabled API Governance & Execution

AI-assisted design, code generation, testing, compliance, and migration, plus risk-based MCP and agent-tool enablement with identity, authorization, human approval, auditability, and lifecycle controls.

- API Operations, Observability & Talent

Reliability engineering, SLOs, resilience, incident and problem management, developer enablement, workforce strategy, succession, capability building, and vendor/platform management.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Product Strategy & Management

  • Own the enterprise API product strategy and operating model, including a published roadmap, investment and funding model, lifecycle, value realization, adoption, reuse, and health metrics.

  • Treat API producers and consumers, internal and external, as customers and use structured voice-of-consumer feedback to prioritize high-leverage, business-critical API products.

  • Maintain a governed API product registry aligned to the Unified API Catalog, with clear ownership, product classification, lifecycle status, dependencies, and business outcomes.

  • Drive measurable reductions in point-to-point integrations, duplication, onboarding time, and cost to serve.

2. API Standards, Governance, Security & Quality Engineering

  • Own and evolve enterprise standards for REST, GraphQL, asynchronous messaging, event-driven APIs, and emerging integration protocols, with API security standards jointly owned with EIP.

  • Govern the full lifecycle through automated intake and controls covering design, documentation, schema validation, development, contract testing, security testing, performance testing, deployment, monitoring, versioning, deprecation, and retirement.

  • Advance the Unified API Gateway and Unified API Catalog, including discoverability, subscription management, reusable patterns, policy enforcement, and real-time governance and compliance reporting.

  • Operationalize zero-trust API security through approved identity and token standards, workload identity, fine-grained authorization, threat protection, secrets management, and OWASP API coverage in partnership with EIP.

  • Establish contract-first engineering, backward-compatibility requirements, consumer-driven contract testing, breaking-change detection, sandbox and mocking capabilities, and release-readiness controls.

3. Omnichannel API Definition & Creation

  • Define and create enterprise Omnichannel APIs aligned to consumer journeys, providing consistent, channel-agnostic access to authoritative capabilities and data across web, mobile, call center, IVR, agent, and partner channels.

  • Establish Omnichannel API design standards, reference patterns, and reusable building blocks so channels use governed enterprise interfaces rather than channel-specific, duplicative APIs.

  • Prioritize business-critical and high-leverage APIs that represent the majority of API volume, and design them with consumable schemas, metadata, documentation, and appropriate AI-agent readiness.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Data & Analytics so API contracts align to authoritative domain capabilities, enterprise information models, and governed data without creating competing sources of truth.

4. API Modernization: Producers & Consumers

  • Own and govern the enterprise API modernization program, sequencing migration of the legacy and fragmented API estate to modern enterprise and Omnichannel interfaces in prioritized waves.

  • Drive producer modernization and consumer migration, transitioning validated active consumers for approved, in-scope retirement candidates with backward compatibility, controlled cutover, rollback readiness, and minimal disruption.

  • Govern dependency discovery, retirement, deprecation, exception management, and the removal of redundant APIs, unsupported gateways, and legacy integration technologies.

  • Track producer modernization, consumer cutover, API retirement, platform adoption, reuse, risk, and business value through executive-visible reporting, using established baselines and data-quality controls.

5. External APIs, Partnerships & Governance

  • Own Humana’s external API strategy and the secure, standards-based exposure of APIs to partners, providers, vendors, and the broader ecosystem as a first-class product surface.

  • Lead the technical management of API-enabled partnerships, including partner segmentation, onboarding, certification and conformance testing, sandbox access, credentials and certificates, SLAs, versioning, support, escalation, and deprecation communications.

  • Establish heightened governance for partner identity, delegated authorization, fine-grained scopes, data sharing, minimum-necessary access, consent, privacy, PHI/PII protection, auditability, and applicable regulatory and interoperability obligations, including CMS and HL7 FHIR where relevant.

  • Govern third-party API consumption through technical due diligence, cataloging, dependency and concentration-risk monitoring, continuity planning, and exit or transition readiness.

  • Provide a governed external developer experience through an external portal, high-quality documentation, self-service onboarding where appropriate, production support, and observability at the edge.

  • Partner with business, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and other accountable functions on agreements and value-realization models, including monetization where strategically and legally appropriate.

6. AI-Enabled API Governance & Execution

  • Embed AI into API design, code generation, documentation, testing, standards validation, migration analysis, and consumer cutover to improve delivery speed and quality.

  • Establish the enterprise approach for safely exposing approved API capabilities to AI agents through MCP and other emerging agent protocols where appropriate, rather than requiring agent enablement for every API.

  • Govern MCP servers and agent tools through bounded tool design, strict schemas, workload and user identity, least-privilege authorization, secrets management, gateway and egress policy enforcement, audit trails, versioning, and deprecation controls.

  • Require human approval and appropriate rollback or recovery mechanisms for high-risk, write, destructive, or material business actions initiated by agents.

  • Apply risk-based governance to internally developed and third-party MCP servers, documenting exceptions and using compensating controls where direct implementation control is limited.

  • Partner with Enterprise AI and Cybersecurity to ensure responsible, secure, observable, and auditable use of AI across the API and integration lifecycle.

7. API Operations, Resilience, Observability & Talent

  • Own the production operating model for shared API platforms, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, capacity, quotas, throttling, dependency mapping, synthetic monitoring, and operational-readiness reviews.

  • Ensure resilience through continuity and disaster-recovery planning, tested failover and recovery procedures, release and rollback readiness, and risk-based multi-region or platform-resilience patterns where required.

  • Lead incident and problem management for shared platforms and critical enterprise interfaces, including timely detection, restoration, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and systemic learning.

  • Build API and integration developer enablement, product documentation, golden paths, communities of practice, and support models that improve adoption and engineering quality across segments.

  • Design and lead the API Technologies organization, including workforce and sourcing strategy, succession planning, leadership development, career paths, performance culture, and capability building across API product management, engineering, security, FHIR, operations, and AI-agent enablement.

  • Manage platform vendors, licensing, FinOps, enterprise-scale budgets, audit readiness, controls, and regulatory compliance.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 8+ years leading API, integration, platform engineering, or product organizations.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise API and integration strategy, product management, standards, governance, gateways, catalogs, event-driven architecture, messaging, streaming, and modern integration patterns.

  • Proven experience defining and governing external and partner APIs, including secure exposure, partner onboarding, certification, developer experience, agreements and SLAs, support, and regulatory compliance.

  • Proven success running APIs or platforms as products, including roadmap and investment ownership, adoption, reuse, consumer experience, value realization, and product health at enterprise scale.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale modernization across producers and consumers, retiring redundant services and legacy integration technologies with minimal disruption.

  • Experience applying AI and automation to API design, delivery, testing, governance, and migration, with knowledge of agentic integration patterns, MCP, or comparable emerging technologies.

  • Strong API and integration security acumen, including OAuth 2.x, approved token standards, workload identity, least privilege, zero-trust principles, secrets management, OWASP API risks, and external-facing authorization.

  • Demonstrated production leadership across reliability engineering, SLOs, resilience, incident and problem management, operational readiness, and continuity planning.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.description:
Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs. This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology. They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges.

The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships. They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership

The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations.
  • Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions.
  • Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.
  • Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services.
  • Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.
  • Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus

Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance

  • Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities.
  • Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management

  • Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs.
  • Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.
  • Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs.

Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance

  • Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.
  • Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications.
  • Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth

  • Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams.
  • Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.
  • Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency.
  • Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time.
  • Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally.

Preferred

  • Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.
  • Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness. They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark

Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands. This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution.

EEO Statement

Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: About MegaportWe’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be.
raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success - West, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will act as the main point of contact and interface with existing customers. This individual will have a core focus on post-sale relationships, with a main focus on upselling/cross-selling, including enablement, service performance, renewals, and supporting the overall customer experience.

They’ll be accountable for driving both incremental sales and retaining existing revenue by proactively reaching out to customers and introducing them to new product enhancements, service developments, pricing initiatives and other benefits of the Megaport proposition.

The position will sit within the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely alongside a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect in the Pacific Northwest region. The CSM plays an integral role on the team, and ultimately, they’ll be responsible for providing ongoing commercial interaction for a designated customer base, aiming to expand, retain, and develop increased value from this nominated account list.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • As part of the Integrated Account Team, this role will collaborate with Direct Sales Executives and Solution Architects to drive, grow and retain targeted revenue from our existing customers, focusing on supporting the overall customer experience.

  • Proactively drive the renewal process across a wide base of customers and Increase long-term revenue potential by converting customers on month-to-month to term subscriptions at renewal.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to existing customers, focusing on initial onboarding and enablement, to ensure quick time to value as well as providing information about Megaport enhancements, new products and ecosystem partners.

  • Be responsible for proactive, sequenced outreach communications across a large base of customers driving further adoption, solution awareness and opportunities to engage with Megaport and our partner community.

  • Champion customers throughout their entire customer journey, including facilitating the resolution of customer-related issues and concerns from a Commercial and Sales standpoint, and understanding how we can add more value.

  • Nurture the nominated customer base, identifying key targets and operating an engagement strategy, based on opportunity and the customer vertical market or needs

  • Report on and analyze customer experience by understanding customer needs, and communicating trends to the wider Megaport team. Report growth opportunities through pipeline updates with SFDC updates.

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of Megaport products and solutions and be able to propose and demonstrate these to the customers, whilst being aware of rival services or products. Maintain and share a value add opinion on Megaport and where we fit in the customer's ecosystem.

  • Review with management to understand key objectives and execute tasks that are aligned with the goals of the business; which will flex per the business focus or plans.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams on campaigns and strategies for revenue growth.

  • Acting as a subject matter expert you will evaluate customer feedback and make recommendations to continually align and improve processes that provide visibility and an understanding and measurement of business performance against targets.

  • Collaborate with other departmental teams (Finance, Operations, etc.) in helping to resolve challenges impacting the customer’s service experience.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years experience within the Enterprise software market or Internet/Telecommunications industries.

  • 3+ years experience in an Account Management or Customer Success role.

  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced technical environment, with multiple tasks or goals.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to collaborate and work effectively across internal and external organisations.

  • Demonstrable ability to identify customer needs, appreciate and understand the customers’ service issues, or “pain points”, and present a suitable solution.

  • Ability to deliver revenue results and operate in a consultative-based selling approach.

  • Ability to work with the wider Megaport teams to focus on revenue generation and results.

  • Maintain records, reports and data as per the Megaport models, with a focus on revenue retention from the existing agreed customer list.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are a must, as well as the ability to work effectively across internal and external organisations.

  • Experience in proposing or deploying cloud and virtualised compute solutions in enterprise customer environments is highly desired.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environments

  • Birthday Leave

  • Generous study and training allowance + 5 days paid study leave

  • Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces

  • Motivated team of industry experts and new talent

  • Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards

  • Health and wellness program

NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). ​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior Accountant/Manager

Compensation range: $2,500 AUD - $3,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a well-established Australian accounting firm with more than four decades of experience supporting individuals and small to medium-sized businesses. The practice provides tax, accounting, bookkeeping, and financial guidance, combining extensive industry experience with a practical, client-focused approach.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant/Manager to take a hands-on role managing a portfolio of Australian SME and individual clients. You’ll prepare and finalise tax and accounting work, manage client relationships, respond to queries, and provide practical tax and compliance advice.

You’ll also mentor intermediate accountants and bookkeepers, monitor workflow and deadlines, and help ensure high-quality work is delivered on time. The ideal candidate is technically strong, organised, client-focused, and confident working autonomously in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and finalise Australian tax returns and financial statements for individuals, trusts, and companies.
  • Review accounting and tax work prepared by intermediate accountants and bookkeepers, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Manage a portfolio of SME and individual clients, acting as a primary point of contact.
  • Communicate directly with clients via email, phone, and other channels, responding promptly and professionally to queries.
  • Provide practical tax planning, compliance, and accounting advice based on current Australian tax legislation.
  • Monitor client work, workflow, and deadlines to ensure ATO, ASIC, and client obligations are met.
  • Mentor and support intermediate accountants and bookkeepers, providing technical guidance and feedback.
  • Monitor team productivity and help identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, quality, and client service across all work.
  • Stay up to date with relevant Australian tax and compliance requirements.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong working knowledge of Australian tax law and its practical application
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — confident corresponding directly with clients
  • Proven experience in a public practice environment
  • Proficient with Xero, FYI, Annature, and Microsoft 365 (or willingness to learn quickly)
  • Able to work autonomously in a remote environment
  • CA/CPA qualified (or equivalent) preferred
  • Demonstrated high academic grades in numeracy and literacy

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.title: AI Lead - Build our new B2B SaaS Business
raw.excerpt: About the RoleLighthouse Software Group is looking for an AI Lead to build and lead it from day one.
raw.description:
About the Role

Lighthouse Software Group is looking for an AI Lead to build and lead it from day one. We partner with vertical market software businesses to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can unlock significant customer value. This new venture will focus on building a developer-first, AI-enabled SaaS platform, designed to integrate seamlessly into existing workflows and scale through strong product adoption.

Here is a little window into our company: Valsoft acquires and develops vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries or niche. A key tenet of Valsoft's philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that molds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management. Valsoft has grown to 130+ companies with 4,000+ employees in 20+ countries. 

Lighthouse Software Group, an operating group of Valsoft, operates and manages Valsoft’s global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry’s best practices, Lighthouse Software Group delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

The market opportunity is proven, fragmented, and ready for transformation. As AI Lead, you will shape the product vision, drive go-to-market execution, build the founding team, and establish market leadership - backed by Aspire and Valsoft’s capital, infrastructure, and global operating expertise.

What you'll be doing 

  • Lead a new B2B SaaS business built around AI and platform innovation in a vertical software market
  • Own AI strategy and execution: identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI use cases
  • Build and ship production-ready AI solutions that drive real customer and revenue outcomes
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Operators to ensure strong adoption and commercialization
  • Define and execute a scalable go-to-market strategy, from early adopters to first customers
  • Set product and market strategy, with a strong focus on developer experience, scalability, and integration
  • Build a milestone-based plan, allocate budget, and support fundraising with Valsoft
  • Assemble and lead a high-performing cross-functional team (product, tech, sales, operations)
  • Work closely with technical leaders to deliver high-quality APIs, SDKs, documentation, and integrations
  • Own and operate the business end-to-end, with full autonomy

What you bring 

  • A founder mindset: You’re motivated by building from scratch and fully owning the journey 
  • 3+ years of experience building or operating AI software, API or SDK based platforms with leadership experience (e.g. Product lead, Startup Founder, or Sales/Operations lead) 
  • Demonstrated success in building early-stage ventures or leading 0→1 product launches, with bachelor in relevant field  
  • Strong understanding of developer-first products, including documentation, onboarding, reliability, and versioning
  • Grit and resourcefulness with proven success of operating without a playbook  
  • Commercial mindset with exposure to pricing, packaging, GTM execution, and customer adoption
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and business domains
  • Ability to drive the overall company vision, culture, and performance 

What you’ll own 

  • P&L responsibility: You’ll run the company day-to-day and long-term 
  • Equity stake: You’ll be a significant shareholder in the business you help create 
  • Product and market vision: You’ll lead strategy, execution, and team alignment 
  • Customer outcomes: You’ll focus relentlessly on value creation for users 

Ready to join a collaborative and innovative team where you can make an immediate impact?

*******************************************************************************************************************************
L'opportunité

Lighthouse Software Group est à la recherche d’un(e) Lead IA pour construire et diriger cette initiative dès le premier jour. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises de logiciels verticaux afin d’identifier des opportunités à fort impact où l’IA peut générer une valeur significative pour les clients. Cette nouvelle initiative se concentrera sur la création d’une plateforme SaaS IA “developer-first”, conçue pour s’intégrer facilement aux flux de travail existants et évoluer grâce à une forte adoption produit.

Voici un aperçu de notre entreprise : Valsoft acquiert et développe des entreprises de logiciels spécialisés (vertical market software), permettant à chacune d’offrir des solutions critiques à forte valeur ajoutée pour leurs clients, dans leur industrie ou niche respective. Un principe fondamental de la philosophie de Valsoft est d’investir dans des entreprises bien établies et de favoriser un environnement entrepreneurial qui permet de bâtir des leaders dans leurs marchés respectifs. Valsoft adopte une approche de long terme, en privilégiant des partenariats durables avec les équipes de gestion en place. Aujourd’hui, Valsoft compte plus de 130 entreprises, 4 000 employés, répartis dans plus de 20 pays.

Lighthouse Software Group, groupe opérateur de Valsoft, gère et développe le portefeuille mondial de sociétés de logiciels détenues à 100 %, en fournissant des solutions critiques à travers de multiples secteurs verticaux. En mettant en œuvre les meilleures pratiques de l’industrie, Lighthouse Software Group assure des intégrations rapides et efficaces. Son modèle décentralisé lui permet de devenir un véritable moteur de croissance, en réinvestissant activement au sein de son portefeuille.

L’opportunité de marché est éprouvée, fragmentée et prête à être transformée. En tant que Lead IA, vous définirez la vision produit, piloterez l’exécution go-to-market, constituerez l’équipe fondatrice et établirez un leadership sur le marché — soutenu par le capital, l’infrastructure et l’expertise opérationnelle mondiale d’Aspire et de Valsoft.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Diriger une nouvelle entreprise B2B SaaS axée sur l’IA et l’innovation de plateforme dans un marché logiciel vertical
  • Être responsable de la stratégie et de l’exécution IA : identifier, prioriser et livrer des cas d’usage IA à fort impact
  • Concevoir et déployer des solutions IA prêtes pour la production, générant une valeur concrète pour les clients et les revenus
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Ventes et Opérations afin d’assurer l’adoption et la commercialisation
  • Définir et exécuter une stratégie go-to-market évolutive, des premiers utilisateurs jusqu’aux premiers clients
  • Définir la stratégie produit et marché, avec un fort accent sur l’expérience développeur, la scalabilité et l’intégration
  • Élaborer un plan basé sur des jalons clés, allouer les budgets et soutenir les efforts de financement avec Valsoft
  • Constituer et diriger une équipe performante et pluridisciplinaire (produit, technologie, ventes, opérations)
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les leaders techniques afin de livrer des API, SDK, documentations et intégrations de haute qualité
  • Diriger et exploiter l’entreprise de bout en bout, avec une autonomie complète

Votre profil

  • Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception ou l'exploitation de logiciels d'IA, de plateformes API ou SDK, avec une expérience en management (par exemple : chef de produit, fondateur de startup ou responsable commercial/opérations).
  • Expérience réussie dans la création d'entreprises en phase de démarrage ou le lancement de produits (de 0 à 1), avec un diplôme de niveau bac+3/4. Expérience pertinente
  • Solide compréhension des produits destinés aux développeurs, notamment en matière de documentation, d'intégration, de fiabilité et de gestion des versions
  • Esprit entrepreneurial : vous êtes motivé(e) par la création d'un produit à partir de zéro et souhaitez en assumer pleinement la responsabilité
  • Persévérance et ingéniosité, avec une expérience réussie de la gestion de projets sans plan préétabli
  • Sens commercial et expérience en matière de tarification, de packaging, de stratégie de mise sur le marché et d'adoption par les clients
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, tant sur le plan technique que commercial
  • Capacité à piloter la vision, la culture et la performance globales de l'entreprise

Vos responsabilités

  • Gestion du compte de résultat : vous assurerez la gestion quotidienne et stratégique de l'entreprise
  • Participation au capital : vous serez un actionnaire important de l'entreprise que vous contribuerez à créer
  • Vision produit et marché : vous piloterez la stratégie, son exécution et la coordination des équipes
  • Satisfaction client : vous vous concentrerez sans relâche sur la création de valeur pour les utilisateurs

Prêt(e) à rejoindre une équipe collaborative et innovante, où vous pouvez avoir un impact immédiat ?

raw.description:
Job Description

With support of other Clinical Research Manager's (CRMs) and/or Therapeutic Area Head (TAH) / Clinical Research Director (CRD), this role is accountable for the end-to-end performance and project management for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP) and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.

The Associate Clinical Research Manager (aCRM) could be responsible for a particular study for a country or a cluster.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Main Point of Contact (POC) for assigned protocols and link between Country Operations and clinical trial team (CTT).
  • Responsible for project management of the assigned studies: pro-actively plans, drives and tracks execution and performance of deliverables/timelines/results to meet country commitments from feasibility and site selection, recruitment, execution and close out.
  • Accountable for performance for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.
  • Reviews Monitoring Visits Reports and escalates performance issues and training needs to Clinical Research Associate Manager (CRAM) and/or functional vendor and internal management as needed.
  • Performs Quality control visits as required.
  • Leads local study teams to high performance: trains in the protocol other local roles, closely collaborates with and supports CRAs as protocol expert and coordinates activities across the different local country roles ensuring a strong collaboration (including the Clinical Trial Coordinators (CTC), Clinical Research Associates' (CRAs) and Clinical Operations Managers (COMs).
  • Responsible for creating and executing a local risk management plan for assigned studies.
  • Ensures compliance with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) and other key systems in assigned studies.
  • Escalates as needed different challenges and issues to TA-Head/CRD/ Country Clinical Quality Manager (CCQM) and or CTT (as appropriate).
  • Identifies and shares best practices.
  • Responsible for collaboration with functional outsourcing vendors, investigators, other external partners in assigned studies.
  • As a customer-facing role, this position will build business relationships and represent our company with investigators.
  • Supports local and regional strategy development consistent with long‐term corporate needs in conjunction with CRD, TA-Head and Regional Operations.
  • Collaborates internally with Headquarters (HQ) functions, regional and local operations, European Union (EU) Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Global Medical and Scientific Affairs to align on key issues/decisions across the trials. Consult with Human Health as needed.

Extent of Travel: Up to 30% of working time.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Skills:

  • Knowledge in Project Management and/or site management.
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated success in related role or discipline required.
  • Requires ability to make decisions independently and oversee important activities relevant to clinical research activities according to predetermined global policies and commitments with the support, oversight and supervision of the TA-Head or CRD
  • Requires understanding of local regulatory environment.
  • Scientific and clinical research knowledge is required.
  • Understanding of clinical trial planning, management and metrics is essential as well as the ability to focus on multiple deliverables and protocols simultaneously.
  • Ability to function as a key link between Country Operations and Clinical Trial Teams
  • Communicates effectively and builds a collaboration spirit in a remote/virtual environment and across countries, cultures and functions.
  • Ability to manage processes (and controls), productivity, quality and project delivery.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English and local language. The incumbent must be competent and effective in written and verbal communication.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote and virtual environment.
  • Aptitude for building leadership skills that enable and drive alignment with the goals, purpose and mission of our Research & Development Division, Global Clinical Development (GCD) and Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO).
  • Ability to identify problems, conflicts and opportunities early, analyses and prepare mitigation plans and drive conflict resolution is critical.
  • Required to negotiate skillfully in tough situations with both internal and external groups; settle differences with minimum disruption.
    • Examples of common problems include:
      • 1) low patient recruitment
      • 2) inadequate staff to meet business needs
      • 3) performance or compliance issues
      • 4) resolution of conflictive situations.
  • Understand cultural differences.
  • Strong diplomatic and empathic skills to effectively build and maintain professional relationships with investigators and other stakeholders.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science (or comparable)
  • 4+ years of experience in clinical research
  • CRA experience preferred
  • Immunology experience preferred

Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

The COA Product and Insights Manager serves as the senior insights and intelligence lead within Wiley's Clinical Outcomes Assessment (COA) Solutions business. The role provides market intelligence, portfolio analytics and competitive insight to inform product strategy, partnership targeting and commercial positioning. It combines hands-on analytical work with cross-functional partnership, working closely with the Senior Product Manager, the broader COA leadership team, and colleagues across IP and Licensing, Product Delivery, Commercial and Scientific functions to ensure decisions are grounded in robust evidence. The role will also establish scalable datasets, dashboards and AI-assisted workflows that strengthen ongoing intelligence capability across the business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead market intelligence and competitive analysis across the COA market, tracking competitor offerings, pricing, positioning, regulatory developments, clinical trial patterns, therapeutic area dynamics and emerging trends.
  • Analyse Wiley's COA portfolio against external demand signals, including clinical trial usage data, label claim precedent, regulatory submissions and competitor catalogues, to identify underleveraged assets, portfolio gaps and opportunities for acquisition, development or repositioning.
  • Translate market and portfolio analysis into clear recommendations that inform product roadmap decisions, instrument prioritisation, partnership targeting and commercial positioning.
  • Build and maintain the datasets, dashboards and analytical tooling that support ongoing intelligence work, ensuring outputs are reproducible, defensible and accessible, and applying AI-assisted workflows where they add value.
  • Benchmark competitor pricing, packaging and positioning to identify pricing opportunities and competitive threats and to support decisions about how Wiley structures, prices and positions its solutions.
  • Partner across IP and Licensing, Product Delivery, Product, Commercial and Scientific teams to ensure insight informs decisions across the business, while surfacing emerging market and regulatory signals and contributing to thought leadership where commercially or strategically useful.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in product management, market intelligence, business analysis, commissioning, research or a comparable analytical and commercially oriented role, with some experience in publishing, healthcare, life sciences or a research-adjacent environment.
  • Strong analytical capability, including experience working with structured and unstructured data, querying public datasets and synthesising disparate sources into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Hands-on capability with technical tooling, including SQL, Python or equivalent, together with working fluency in AI-assisted analytical workflows and judgement about where they add value.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, such as life sciences, data science, business, economics, social sciences or humanities.
  • Track record of translating analysis into clear, defensible recommendations for senior stakeholders, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrable curiosity and self-direction, with the ability to scope and prioritise analytical work in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment without prescriptive direction.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and inform colleagues without direct authority and to operate with significant autonomy.
  • Sound judgement about which questions matter most, with the discipline to prioritise high-leverage work over interesting but lower-value analysis.
  • Ability to travel primarily for industry conferences, team gatherings, and occasional customer or partner engagement. Approximately 10% to 15% per year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Direct experience with Clinical Outcomes Assessment (COA), electronic Clinical Outcomes Assessment (eCOA), clinical trials or health technology assessment (HTA) ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with clinical trial data sources, including ClinicalTrials.gov, AACT or equivalent, and other public scientific or commercial datasets.
  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical research and development processes, decision frameworks and procurement dynamics.
  • Experience with scholarly publishing, rights management or licensing environments.
  • Experience building proprietary intelligence through web scraping, semantic comparison or similar data extraction approaches.
  • Experience working in matrixed or cross-functional organisations on commercially material analytical work.

We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a Systems Integration Specialist to support the ICE Health Service Corps (IHSC) Health Information Technology Unit (HITU) IT modernization by coordinating, validating, and supporting systems integration efforts across platforms, applications, and data sources. This role focuses on enabling interoperability and ensuring alignment of vendor-delivered and internal systems with IHSC architecture, security, and operational requirements.

The Systems Integration Specialist supports the development and maintenance of system interfaces, coordinates with vendors and internal teams, and documents integration architectures, interface specifications, and data flows. The role supports integration testing and helps identify and resolve integration defects, data inconsistencies, and performance issues.

The ideal candidate understands systems integration and interoperability principles and can collaborate effectively with Solutions Developers, Business Analysts, and Data Engineers. Work is performed within authorized environments and in compliance with security, privacy, and governance requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support coordination, validation, and integration activities across IHSC Health IT platforms and applications.
  • Support development and maintenance of system interfaces by coordinating with vendors and internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Developers, Business Analysts, and Data Engineers to ensure technical solutions align with functional requirements.
  • Support integration testing, validation, and acceptance activities.
  • Document integration architectures, interface specifications, and data flows.
  • Assist in identifying and resolving integration defects, data inconsistencies, and performance issues.
  • Support system enhancements and IT modernization initiatives involving multiple interconnected systems.
  • Ensure integrations comply with security, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Participate in change management and release activities related to integrated solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of systems integration principles, including application interoperability, data exchange, and interface design.
  • Experience supporting integration of enterprise IT systems, including coordination between front-end applications, back-end services, and data platforms.
  • Ability to assist with design, configuration, and testing of system integrations under senior technical guidance.
  • Familiarity with API-based integrations, event-driven architecture, data feeds, and system-to-system communication methods.
  • Ability to document technical architecture, integration flows, and interface specifications.
  • Skill in identifying and troubleshooting integration defects, data inconsistencies, and performance issues.
  • Understanding of change management and release processes within a structured development environment.

The Sales Development Representative role provides an exciting platform for career development for sales-oriented, ambitious, hungry individuals who have a creative & entrepreneurial flair, along with highly developed communication skills. You'll play a strategic role in the company's continued growth by finding and breaking into the next premier customers for FICO's flagship cloud software products. Experience of working in a fast-paced commercial environment is essential. Previous sales experience is desirable. The ability to develop relationships, drive, and ambition are the key skills required.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Actively identify and research potential customers through outbound efforts, including cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach,leveraging AI tools such as Claude to build comprehensive prospect profiles, generate tailored messaging, and identify key business drivers before making contact.

  • Respond to inbound leads and cultivate a strong pipeline by qualifying and converting marketing leads into sales-ready meetings and opportunities for Key Account Managers, using AI-assisted insights to prioritise target accounts, maintain cadence discipline, and ensure leads are qualified against FICO's Platform Capabilities.

  • Plan and research to engage prospects through personalised communication and follow-ups, leveraging AI tools to deepen understanding of prospect pain points and match FICO solutions to their specific business challenges and desired outcomes.

  • Position FICO's platform value proposition effectively, demonstrating a consultative approach and the ability to handle objections confidently, drawing on solution knowledge, customer success stories, and competitive differentiators to carry credible conversations with prospects.

  • Develop extensive solution knowledge and stay updated on industry trends and competitor offerings, using AI tools to continuously deepen expertise and provide detailed insight to prospects.

  • Collaborate with Key Account Managers on account and territory strategy, focusing on areas where KAMs aren't currently reaching and sharing AI-generated prospect summaries and meeting briefs for highly contextualised first meetings while working with Field Marketing to refine messaging and lead generation strategy based on campaign performance.

  • Exercise resilience and self-motivation to thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, maintaining a no-excuses approach to hitting targets and adapting techniques when facing objections or obstacles.

What We’re Seeking

  • Native French/English speaker with excellent communication skills and a strong capacity to develop relationships quickly over the phone, through email, and social channels.

  • Experience working in a results-oriented or sales environment; experience in Inside Sales, Sales Development, or Business Development is desirable, as is experience within financial services or a technology company/prospecting into the technology industry.

  • Educated to degree standard or have gained the same level of experience operating in a commercial environment.

  • Ability to perform individually and as part of a high-performing team.

  • Effective problem-solving and time management skills with the curiosity and agility to try new outreach angles and adapt when approaches aren't working, combined with the ability to think strategically, critically, and leverage data in decision-making.

  • Understanding of broad business dynamics and how large, complex companies operate.

  • Detailed, motivated self-starter who thrives in complex and challenging environments of a rapidly evolving business, with openness to coaching and continuous learning, receptive to feedback, willing to experiment with new skills, and able to apply newly acquired techniques quickly and consistently.

Our Offer to You

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Job Posting Title:

Senior Concept Artist

Req ID:

10157163

Job Description:

ESPN is seeking a highly imaginative and versatile Senior Concept Artist to help shape the future of sports storytelling across broadcast, digital, social, experiential, and emerging platforms. This role is ideal for a strategic visual thinker who can take big ideas from early exploration through polished creative execution, translating abstract concepts into compelling visual systems, storyboards, proof-of-concept frames, motion studies, and final design solutions.

The ideal candidate is both an exceptional maker and a confident creative leader; someone who can generate industry-leading work, guide multi-disciplinary teams, and partner across ESPN, Disney, and external stakeholder groups to deliver innovative creative at the highest level. This person should be comfortable moving between concept development, art direction, motion design, animation, live-action production, and emerging technologies, while helping build creative systems designed for long-term success.

Responsibilities:

  • Create industry-leading concept work that brings ambitious ideas to life, from early storyboards and visual exploration to proof-of-concept frames and refined final creative.
  • Develop and oversee multi-disciplinary creative across platforms and products, including broadcast graphics, video editing, motion design, animation, live action, digital, social, and experiential work.
  • Lead, guide, and collaborate with large, multi-layered creative teams with confidence, fairness, transparency, and a strong sense of creative purpose.
  • Direct strategic creative systems, visual toolkits, and design frameworks engineered for consistency, scalability, and long-term success.
  • Lead advanced motion design and animation builds while staying current with evolving industry tools, technology, and production workflows.
  • Concept, direct, and support live-action shoots, including creative development, production planning, and post-production execution.
  • Prepare and present creative briefs, concepts, and strategic recommendations to internal teams, senior leadership, external partners, and stakeholders.
  • Push creative excellence and innovation in AR, VR, XR, real-time graphics, and emerging storytelling spaces.
  • Partner with stakeholder groups across ESPN and Disney to ensure alignment, collaboration, and successful creative outcomes.
  • Mentor, coach, and elevate emerging designers, animators, and artists across the team.
  • Stay curious and knowledgeable about design trends, emerging technologies, sports media, visual storytelling, and industry best practices to help maintain ESPN’s position as a leader in sports design.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-level concept development, art direction, visual storytelling, and polished design execution.
  • Proven ability to translate strategic goals, brand systems, and creative briefs into compelling visual concepts.
  • Experience developing creative from early exploration through final execution, including storyboards, mood boards, proof-of-concept frames, style frames, and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of composition, typography, color, layout, motion principles, and visual hierarchy.
  • Experience working across multiple creative disciplines, including design, animation, motion graphics, video, or 3D concept development.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with creative directors, designers, animators, editors, producers, stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain creative ideas and respond thoughtfully to feedback.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-visibility creative environment.
  • Curiosity about emerging creative tools, technologies, design trends, and evolving production workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating high-end 3D concepts, style frames, visual systems, or proof-of-concept work for broadcast, sports, entertainment, or live-event storytelling.
  • Experience contributing to large-scale tentpole events, premium broadcast packages, or high-profile brand initiatives.
  • Advanced knowledge of tools such as Cinema 4D, Houdini, Unreal Engine, Redshift, After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or related creative platforms.
  • Strong motion design, animation, editing, or live-action production experience.
  • Experience building creative systems, toolkits, or scalable design frameworks across platforms.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or providing creative direction to designers, animators, or multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Passion for sports, culture, technology, innovation, and the future of visual storytelling.

  • High School Diploma

  • College degree in related fields

Our client in the UK is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Data Executive to join their team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone starting their career in data, marketing, or analytics to gain hands-on experience in list building, data hygiene, and reporting.

You'll work closely with the wider team to ensure data is accurate, well-maintained, and used effectively to support business decisions. This apprenticeship combines structured on-the-job training with formal learning, building the skills and knowledge needed for a long-term career in data.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

List Building

  • Work with internal stakeholders to understand list requirements and criteria.

Data Hygiene

General

Requirements

Essential

  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (or willingness to learn quickly).
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A proactive, curious mindset with a genuine interest in data.

Desirable

  • Interest in a career in data, analytics, or marketing operations.

WHAT YOU'LL GAIN
