raw.description:
L'équipe Sales s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ta mission :

Identifier, engager et qualifier les décideurs RH les plus pertinents afin de générer des opportunités commerciales à fort potentiel pour AssessFirst.
Grâce à une approche consultative et orientée données, tu aides tes interlocuteurs à prendre conscience de leurs enjeux RH et leur montres comment AssessFirst peut les aider à révéler le potentiel humain au sein de leur organisation.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien :

  • Construire et piloter ta stratégie de prospection sur le BeLux & la Suisse en priorisant les comptes et segments à plus fort potentiel.

  • Identifier et engager des décideurs RH grâce à une approche multicanale : téléphone, email, LinkedIn, événements, inbound…

  • Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes interlocuteurs pour faire émerger des opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Qualifier rigoureusement les opportunités et assurer une passation fluide aux Account Executives et aux Account Managers

  • Exploiter les données CRM, signaux de marché, outils de ciblage et d’automatisation pour maximiser ton impact.

  • Tester et améliorer en continu les messages, séquences et stratégies d’approche adaptés à ton marché.

  • Partager tes apprentissages terrain pour contribuer à construire et faire évoluer notre Go-To-Market sur la zone.

  • Participer à la visibilité d’AssessFirst à travers des campagnes, événements et initiatives locales.

Tes objectifs :

✅ Générer un pipeline qualifié et à fort potentiel de conversion sur le BeLux & la Suisse.
✅ Développer notre présence auprès de comptes stratégiques et de décideurs RH.
✅ Identifier les approches et segments permettant d’accélérer notre développement sur ces marchés.
✅ Assurer un suivi rigoureux des opportunités et alimenter le CRM avec des données fiables et exploitables.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle :

Tu sais ouvrir un marché : tu es autonome pour analyser ton territoire, prioriser tes comptes et construire ton plan d’attaque.

Tu es orienté résultats : tu sais concentrer ton énergie sur les actions qui créent réellement du pipeline.

Tu es stratégiquement "paresseux·se" : tu automatises les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée pour consacrer ton temps aux conversations qui comptent.

Tu es à l’aise avec la donnée : tu l’utilises pour prioriser, personnaliser tes approches et améliorer tes performances.

Tu es curieux·se et proactif·ve : tu testes, apprends et ajustes rapidement ton approche en fonction du marché.

Tu es un joueur collectif : tu travailles étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Marketing et Revenue Operations pour faire progresser l’ensemble du moteur commercial.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de la team BDR, composée de 12 personnes.

Tu travailleras également très étroitement avec l'équipe Account Executive et Account Manager !

Expérience souhaitée

🏃 Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en prospection / Business Development B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou Tech.

💻 Tu es très à l’aise avec les outils digitaux, notamment les outils d’IA

🔥 Tu sais engager tes interlocuteurs avec des approches pertinentes, personnalisées et accrocheuses.

🏆 Tu as une vraie culture de la performance, le goût du challenge et l’envie d’ouvrir de nouveaux marchés.

🌍 La maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :Package 70K (45K fixe) -variable déplafonné

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle

  2. Tu remplis nos questionnaires en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email)

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 4 entretiens maximum : Ton futur N+1, un cas pratique, un échange avec Quentin (CRO) et David notre CEO !

  5. Bienvenue dans l'équipe, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe !

Department: Advanced Power Systems (APS). This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management System IC Architecture for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary System IC Architect with deep expertise in system-level architecture, high-performance power conversion, and semiconductor packaging technologies. This role is pivotal in defining next-generation Point of Load (PoL) solutions for APS, driving innovation in advanced power management with System-in-Package (SiP) integration.

We’re looking for a candidate to define products, shape architecture strategy, and support the launch of Point-of-Load (PoL) power solutions that meet latest system-level requirements. Key focus areas include high-performance core power for automotive applications and AI compute platforms. The role centers on Advanced Power Management for PoL solutions. Expertise in AI compute power is essential, and experience in automotive power management is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities – Advanced Power Management & System IC Architecture

Product Definition & Strategy

  • Own System IC Architecture, to define product concepts and specifications for power semiconductor modules and System-in-Package (SiP) solutions. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Develop and maintain long-term product and technology roadmaps in collaboration with product line leaders and R&D teams.

  • Translate customer requirements into innovative packaging and power management solutions. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Support development through thermal optimization and electrical analysis.

System-Level Integration

  • Partner with system solution architects and IC product architects to ensure solutions meet stringent performance, efficiency, space, and cost targets.

  • Lead integration of ICs and power semiconductors into advanced packages and systems. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions. Expertise in System-in-Package (SiP) integration is essential.

  • Drive early-phase engineering and architecture for AI compute, automotive 48V systems, and electrification platforms. Knowledge of AI Compute Power Solutions is critical. Automotive Power Management experience is a plus, highly valued.

Thermal Management & Advisory

  • Analyze customer-specific needs to deliver optimized power efficiency and thermal management strategies for enhanced reliability. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with system, modeling, design, packaging and manufacturing engineering teams to validate and optimize high-performance compute Power designs.

  • Act as a technical liaison with customers, supporting co-development and design-in activities.

Technical Advisory & Reporting

  • Provide strategic insights on state-of-the-art power management technologies and benchmark readiness. This role emphasizes Advanced Power Management for Point of Load (PoL) solutions.

  • Report KPIs and project status to executive stakeholders.

You will work on building scalable APIs and optimizing backend services for performance and reliability.

  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality, scalable, and efficient software applications and architecture.

  • Exposure to a product-based environment.
  • Solid debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with exquisite attention to detail and the ability to think strategically and logically.

Soft Skills

  • Ownership mentality with strong problem-solving instincts.
  • Clear communication across distributed teams; capable of driving architectural trade-offs.
  • Ability to balance strategic vision with execution at scale.
  • Collaborative mindset and commitment to engineering excellence.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML models into production systems.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, benchmarked to experience and market standards.

Why Join Evolphin

Job Title

Web Developer

Location

Global

Position Type

Volunteer

Job Description

Volunteer Position
We are seeking full time and volunteer professional Web Developers. Use your web skills to improve key websites supporting language development and Bible translation work worldwide. Make an impact by getting important information to language workers to improve their work quality and avoid delays.

SIL International is a faith-based nonprofit organization committed to serving translation teams worldwide. If you believe, as we do, that all languages are of value, form an integral part of people’s identity, and have the potential to serve them in a rapidly changing world, then you can be part of a software team serving translation teams worldwide.

Summary:

A Web Developer has extensive technical expertise and can work independently or with a team to create, maintain, and update client websites in a variety of formats. Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and web applications and services is essential for succeeding in this role. The web developer will have an immediate impact on our brand and those of our clients, and will help solidify SIL's reputation for quality products and academic excellence. They will work together with the Director to plan upgrades to existing sites, and to map out design and functionality improvements, including selecting the best community plugins and built-in features to build the proposed functionality into the site.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Builds, designs, and maintains websites and software applications.

  • Designs, writes, and edits website content.

  • Executes assignments with the use of web applications, scripts, and programming languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and APIs.

  • Participate as an integral and enthusiastic part of the team, exhibiting ownership, follow-through, initiative, awareness, and effective communication with peers and management.

  • Work with the team around a cohesive product roadmap

Minor Responsibilities:

  • Analyze software requirements by consulting with the user community

  • Support user community with developer-level support

  • Write technical reference documentation for managing websites.

  • Participate in regular project status, planning, partnership, and strategic meetings

  • Be available to travel to meet with the larger development team at least once per year

  • Be available to travel biannually to the Language Technology Conference

  • Participate in professional conferences and meetings

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • A servant heart attitude

  • Demonstrated skills in website development

  • Demonstrated skills in SEO

  • Demonstrated skills in WordPress, HTML, and CSS

  • PHP coding ability - helpful but not required. Our preference is to use popular community modules that will guarantee an easier upgrade path for future versions of the platform. A PHP coder would be welcome to contribute code to existing WordPress modules.

  • Good interpersonal skills of communication

  • Good organizational skills

  • The ability to make decisions in a timely manner

  • The ability to generate multiple solutions to the problem

  • The ability to quickly pick up technical concepts

  • The ability to work both with a team and independently, and to multitask effectively

Education and Experience:

Web Developers should have experience in website development and SEO. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent work experience is preferred, but we care more for a heart and mind that are always learning.

Training and Orientation:

Will complete the initial IT Software Department training program and relevant portions of IT Orientation.

Weekly Hours

40

Worldwide Express operates within a fast-paced industry that draws motivated, quick-thinking and proactive people. The company nurtures a culture where ideas, questions, challenges, open two-way communication and risk-taking are welcomed without fear of failure.

The Worldwide Express Freight Operations Manager position is designed to be an integral part of the Freight Operations Team. This position focuses on managing the day-to-day operation of a high-volume freight desk as well as providing development and training for all members of the Freight Desk team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage day-to-day activities of the Freight Desk and Freight Specialists
  • Management of monthly schedule of vacations and holidays
  • Management of phone and ticket traffic via ZenDesk
  • Handling of escalated customer and field issues
  • Implementation of standard operating procedures and training programs
  • Planning and coordination of employee skills and career development
  • Conducting of employee Reviews

•7AM - 4PM PST SCHEDULE

  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Proactive demeanor and strong attention to detail

High school diploma or equivalent experience

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

Create Music Group is currently looking for a passionate digital marketing specialist to join our team! The Marketing Specialist will provide daily support and work with our Marketing team on various aspects of our artist's marketing campaigns.

Responsibilities

Collaborate on the execution of marketing campaigns, including but not limited to:

  • Contributing to the overall plan and strategy
  • Assisting with post seeding and implementation
  • Tracking post metrics and analyzing results across all applicable social media platforms
  • Client facing tracking such as Creator core
  • Internal tracking on Google sheets and docs for tracking and accounting purposes
  • Tracking campaign performance to better optimize artist success and budget monitoring
  • Understand different fandoms and find unique ways to engage with the fans/audiences
  • Finding and understanding fan pages
  • Understanding “clipping” and various ways to source content
  • Have your ear to the ground for best practices and what’s trending
  • Research different key influencers and media outlets to partner with for specific songs/campaigns
  • Update spreadsheets and help with administrative work in the team
  • Familiarity with YouTube shorts and how to post short form content
  • Understand Instagram seeding (blogs) and how to come up with headlines and captions that grab audience’s attention

Qualifications

  • Eager to learn music marketing tactics and strategy
  • Extremely knowledgeable in social media platforms, including Youtube, Instagram and TikTok, and X (Previously Twitter)
  • Strong interest in Pop Culture and following social media trends
  • Extremely knowledgeable in Music and Music Marketing
  • Excellent organization skills & extremely detail-oriented
  • Knowledgeable of Google Suite
  • Bonus: Knowledgeable in Adobe Suite, Canva, or other similar content editing tools/software

Pay Scale

  • $23-28.00 hourly
  • The final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

Fair Chance Policy

In accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications and the nature of the offense in relation to the job for which they are applying.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Job Summary

We are seeking a commercially-minded Performance Ads Manager to drive high-quality lead generation and growth for our clients. In this role, you will be directly responsible for the success of client "open days," ensuring events are fully booked while maintaining efficient acquisition costs. You won't just be pushing buttons in an ad manager; you will act as a strategic partner, constantly analyzing local competition, testing creative boundaries, and optimizing the entire funnel from click to conversion. This is an opportunity for a proactive professional to join a tight-knit team where ownership is valued and your impact is visible every day.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and scale paid social campaigns to ensure client open days are consistently at full capacity.
  • Maintain and optimize CPL (Cost Per Lead) within agreed-upon target ranges.
  • Monitor and improve the Lead-to-Booking rate through constant funnel analysis.
  • Conduct ongoing competitive research to ensure our clients remain leaders in their local markets.
  • Develop and test new creative concepts in collaboration with content creators.
  • Continuously evolve and A/B test landing pages to maximize conversion performance.
  • Provide detailed monthly reporting, documenting all meaningful optimizations and strategic shifts.
  • Utilize Anytrack for server-side tracking to ensure data accuracy and attribution.

Requirements

  • Business Maturity: A high level of professional ownership, clear communication, and the accountability to learn from mistakes and pivot quickly.
  • Creative Strategy: Proven experience developing creative strategies and directing content creators to produce high-performing assets.
  • Agency Experience: A solid understanding of the agency ecosystem and the ability to thrive within a small, collaborative team.
  • Performance Mindset: Deep technical knowledge of paid media platforms and a track record of hitting specific conversion targets.
  • Timezone: Ability to work standard UK business hours.
  • Technical Versatility: A broader understanding of digital marketing to support a small, agile team across various functions.
  • Platform Knowledge: Proficiency with GoHighLevel (CRM) and Basecamp (Project Management).
  • AI & Automation: Experience implementing AI tools intelligently and building automations to increase efficiency.

Benefits

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀Career growth opportunities within a growing agency

📈 Long-term stability and a supportive team culture

🛠️ Access to modern tracking and automation tools

raw.description:
This is a hands-on technical leadership position, combining people management, cloud architecture, platform engineering, and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Software, you'll lead a distributed infrastructure team spanning the UK and India while working closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure cloud solutions. The position is open for full remote within the UK, but there’s preference for profiles who are commutable to Bath weekly – our hybrid policy stablishes 3 days per week in the office.

You'll provide technical direction across two business units, with a primary focus on Maplecroft's AWS-based platforms, including:

  1. GRiD (Global Risk Dashboard) – Maplecroft’s current flagship risk analytics platform, comprising a microservice architecture for mapping, commodity-specific and industry-specific data, and core country risk data.

  1. DataX – Maplecroft’s internal platform for large-scale data processing, building and quality-assuring the risk indices that feed our client-facing products.

  1. GRiD 2 – Maplecroft’s next-generation risk analytics platform, which will replace GRiD as our flagship SaaS product for risk management. GRiD 2 is built on Synergy Studio (VSS), a platform owned by our parent business unit, Catastrophe and Risk Solutions.

Working within a modern cloud ecosystem leveraging AWS, AWS CDK, OpenTofu, ECS Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora, Batch, Step Functions, GitHub and Okta, you'll help guide architectural decisions, support platform modernisation, and drive engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to influence the future of industry-leading risk analytics platforms while remaining deeply involved in technical decision-making. You'll work with modern AWS technologies, help shape engineering strategy, lead talented engineers, and contribute to the development of the next generation of Maplecroft's products in a collaborative, innovation-focused environment.
